board.agent.folded.description: Tooltip on a folded card's agent dot: the agent's name and what it is doing ({status}: "Working…", "Not running").

board.agent.notRunning.description: A card's agent's state, on the card: its session isn't running.

board.agent.removed.description: A card's agent that was removed from its project, on the card. {agent} is its name.

board.agent.tip.description: Tooltip on a card's agent line: the agent's name and what it is doing ({status}: "Working…", "Not running").

board.agent.unnamed.description: Stands for a card's agent when its name isn't known (it was removed), in place of a name in other messages. Lower case.

board.archiveAll.allBusy.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {Every card here is one an agent is on. Tick the box below to archive it anyway.} other {Every card here is one an agent is on. Tick the box below to archive them anyway.}}
board.archiveAll.allBusy.description: In the Archive All dialog when an agent is on every card it would archive ({n} cards). The box is "Also archive cards agents are working on".

board.archiveAll.button.description: The Archive All dialog's button: archives {n} cards.

board.archiveAll.columnCount.description: In the Archive All dialog for the whole board: how many cards it archives from a column ("Done 4"), listed with the other columns.

board.archiveAll.filteredNote.defaultMessage: Cards the search or filter hides stay on the board.
board.archiveAll.filteredNote.description: In the Archive All dialog when a search or filter narrows the board.

board.archiveAll.heldIncluded.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {Archived too: a card an agent is on} other {Archived too: # cards agents are on}}
board.archiveAll.heldIncluded.description: In the Archive All dialog, above the cards agents are on, when the user ticked to archive them too ({n} cards).

board.archiveAll.heldRow.description: A card an agent is on, listed in the Archive All dialog: its name (its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none), title and who is on it ({why}: "Alfie is working on it").

board.archiveAll.heldRowSkipped.description: A card an agent is on, listed in the Archive All dialog, which it leaves on the board: its name (its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none), title and who is on it ({why}: "Alfie is working on it").

board.archiveAll.heldSkipped.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {Skipped: a card an agent is on} other {Skipped: # cards agents are on}}
board.archiveAll.heldSkipped.description: In the Archive All dialog, above the cards agents are on, which it leaves on the board ({n} cards).

board.archiveAll.includeBusy.defaultMessage: Also archive cards agents are working on
board.archiveAll.includeBusy.description: A checkbox in the Archive All dialog: archives the cards agents are on too.

board.archiveAll.includeWarning.defaultMessage: Their agents lose their card: an archived card can't be changed or moved by them, and a watch on it ends, telling the agent it was archived.
board.archiveAll.includeWarning.description: A warning in the Archive All dialog once the user ticks to archive the cards agents are on. A watch is how an agent waits for a card to change.

board.archiveAll.menuAll.description: Menu item in the board's ⋯ menu: archive all {total} cards. Opens a dialog (…).

board.archiveAll.menuColumn.description: Menu item in a board column's ⋯ menu: archive all {total} cards of the column ({column}, its name). Opens a dialog (…).

board.archiveAll.menuShown.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {Archive the # Shown Card (of {total, number})…} other {Archive the # Shown Cards (of {total, number})…}}
board.archiveAll.menuShown.description: Menu item in the board's ⋯ menu, when a search hides some cards: archive the {n} cards shown, of the board's {total}. Opens a dialog (…).

board.archiveAll.menuShownIn.description: Menu item in a board column's ⋯ menu, when a search hides some of its cards: archive the {n} cards shown, of the column's {total}. Opens a dialog (…).

board.archiveAll.messageAll.defaultMessage: Archive {n, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}}? You can unarchive them from Archived.
board.archiveAll.messageAll.description: The Archive All dialog for the whole board: archives its {n} cards. Archived is the checkbox that shows archived cards.

board.archiveAll.messageColumn.defaultMessage: Archive {n, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}} in {column}? You can unarchive them from Archived.
board.archiveAll.messageColumn.description: The Archive All dialog for a column: archives its {n} cards ({column}, its name). Archived is the checkbox that shows archived cards.

board.archiveAll.messageShown.defaultMessage: Archive the {n, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}} shown (of {total, number})? You can unarchive them from Archived.
board.archiveAll.messageShown.description: The Archive All dialog for the whole board when a search narrows it: archives the {n} cards shown, of the board's {total}. Archived is the checkbox that shows archived cards.

board.archiveAll.messageShownIn.defaultMessage: Archive the {n, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}} shown in {column} (of {total, number})? You can unarchive them from Archived.
board.archiveAll.messageShownIn.description: The Archive All dialog for a column a search narrows: archives the {n} cards shown in {column} (its name), of its {total}. Archived is the checkbox that shows archived cards.

board.archiveAll.noneLeft.defaultMessage: {hasColumn, select, yes {No cards are left in {column} to archive: they moved on while this was open.} other {No cards are left to archive: they moved on while this was open.}}
board.archiveAll.noneLeft.description: In the Archive All dialog when every card it would have archived left while it was open (moved to another column or stage, or archived): nothing is left to archive. With hasColumn yes, {column} is the column's or stage's name (select: translate each sentence).

board.archiveAll.titleAll.description: Title of the Archive All dialog for the whole board.

board.archiveAll.titleColumn.description: Title of the Archive All dialog for a board column ({column}, its name).

board.archiveAll.titleShown.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {Archive the # Shown Card?} other {Archive the # Shown Cards?}}
board.archiveAll.titleShown.description: Title of the Archive All dialog for the whole board when a search narrows its cards: the {n} cards shown.

board.archiveAll.titleShownIn.description: Title of the Archive All dialog for a column whose cards a search narrows: the {n} cards shown in the column ({column}, its name).

board.archived.agent.description: A column header of the archived cards' table: the agent the card last had.

board.archived.allBatches.description: The archived cards' batch picker's first choice: every archived card, whatever archived it.

board.archived.archived.description: A column header of the archived cards' table: when the card was archived (a date and time).

board.archived.batch.description: Label of the archived cards' batch picker: which bulk archive (Archive All) to show.

board.archived.count.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# archived card} other {# archived cards}}
board.archived.count.description: Above the archived cards' table: how many archived cards it shows.

board.archived.countSelected.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# archived card} other {# archived cards}} · {selected, plural, one {# selected} other {# selected}}
board.archived.countSelected.description: Above the archived cards' table: how many archived cards it shows ({n}) and how many of them are selected ({selected}).

board.archived.created.description: A column header of the archived cards' table: when the card was created (a date and time).

board.archived.from.description: A column header of the archived cards' table: the board column the card was archived from.

board.archived.labels.description: A column header of the archived cards' table: the card's labels.

board.archived.none.description: The archived cards' view (and its table) when there are none.

board.archived.noneMatch.description: The archived cards' view when none match the board's search.

board.archived.openRow.description: Accessible name of a row of the archived cards' table: opens the card. {card} is its name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none, {title} its title.

board.archived.project.description: A column header of the archived cards' table: the card's project.

board.archived.selectRow.description: Accessible name of a row's checkbox in the archived cards' table. {card} is the card’s name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.

board.archived.title.description: A column header of the archived cards' table: the card's title.

board.archived.unarchive.description: Button on an archived card in the archived cards' table: brings it back to the board.

board.archived.unarchiveBatch.description: Button above the archived cards' table: brings the {n} cards of the chosen bulk archive back where they were.

board.archived.unarchiveBatchTip.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {Bring the # card archived in this batch back to its column, where it was} other {Bring the # cards archived in this batch back to their columns, where they were}}
board.archived.unarchiveBatchTip.description: Tooltip on Unarchive this batch: brings the {n} cards of one bulk archive back where they were on the board.

board.archived.unarchiveSelected.description: Button above the archived cards' table (off while none is selected): brings the selected cards back to the board.

board.archived.unarchiveSelectedN.description: Button above the archived cards' table: brings the {n} selected cards back to the board.

board.archived.unarchiveTip.defaultMessage: Bring {card} back to the end of {column}
board.archived.unarchiveTip.description: Tooltip on an archived card's Unarchive button. {card} is its name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none, {column} the board column it was archived from.

board.attach.already.description: A notice (HI-1700): the card {card} already keeps the same file ({file}), so nothing was added.

board.attach.attached.description: A notice (HI-1700): a session's attachment ({file}: its name) was copied to the card {card} (its key).

board.attach.drafts.defaultMessage: Not saved yet: kept with the card when you {box, select, comment {post the comment} other {save}}
board.attach.drafts.description: Under a box of the card dialog (HI-1700), beside files pasted or dropped into it: they are kept with the card only once the comment is posted, or the card saved.

board.attach.failed.description: An error's title (HI-1700): copying a session's attachment ({file}) to a card failed.

board.attach.heading.description: A heading in the card dialog (HI-1700): the files kept with the card, and how many ({n}).

board.attach.hint.defaultMessage: Paste or drop files into the description or a comment to keep them with the card.
board.attach.hint.description: Under the Attachments heading of the card dialog when the card has none yet (HI-1700).

board.attach.meta.description: Under a card attachment's name (HI-1700): its size, who added it and when ({when}: "4 minutes ago").

board.attach.missing.description: A card attachment whose file is no longer on disk (HI-1700): shown on it, with Remove.

board.attach.open.description: A card attachment's action (HI-1700): opens an image or PDF in its program.

board.attach.otherCards.description: A heading in the menu that copies a session's attachment to a card (HI-1700): the project's cards the agent isn't on.

board.attach.paneHeader.description: The heading of the menu that copies a session's attachment ({file}: its name) to a card (HI-1700), from an agent's pane or the Attachments tab.

board.attach.remove.description: A card attachment's action (HI-1700): takes it off the card (to the Recycle Bin), after asking.

board.attach.removeDraft.description: Button on a file pasted or dropped into the card dialog, not saved yet (HI-1700): takes it out, with its link in the text.

board.attach.removeMessage.defaultMessage: {used, select, none {It goes to the Recycle Bin.} other {It goes to the Recycle Bin. It is shown in {used}: those links will say it was removed.}}
board.attach.removeMessage.description: The confirmation before removing a card attachment (HI-1700); {used}: where the card shows it ("the description and 2 comments"), or none.

board.attach.removeTitle.description: Title of the confirmation before removing a card attachment (HI-1700). {card} is the card’s name: its key, such as AM-12.

board.attach.removed.description: In a card's description or comment (HI-1700): a link to an attachment that was removed from the card since; {name} is the file's name as the text gave it.

board.attach.show.description: A card attachment's action (HI-1700): shows the file in File Explorer.

board.attach.showInTab.description: A link beside the card dialog's Attachments heading (HI-1841): opens the project's Attachments tab on Card attachments, at this card's files.

board.attach.toCard.description: A menu entry (HI-1700): copies a session's attachment to the card {card} (its key, such as AM-12) that the agent works on or reviews.

board.attach.tooLarge.defaultMessage: {name} is larger than {max}, the most a card keeps in one file (Settings → Advanced → Card attachments: largest file).
board.attach.tooLarge.description: An error in the card dialog (HI-1700): a pasted or dropped file is larger than the limit ({max}: a size such as 25 MB); it was not added.

board.attach.tooMuch.defaultMessage: At most {files, number} files and {total} can be saved at once, the description and the comment together.
board.attach.tooMuch.description: An error in the card dialog (HI-1700): more files, or more bytes in all ({total}: a size such as 100 MB), than one Save or Post takes; the last ones were not added.

board.attach.where.defaultMessage: {description, select, yes {the description} other {}}{both, select, yes { and } other {}}{comments, plural, =0 {} one {a comment} other {# comments}}
board.attach.where.description: Where a card shows an attachment (HI-1700), in the remove confirmation: the description, and/or how many comments.

board.batch.andMore.description: Cards that could not be brought back from an archive, cut short: the first six card numbers ({cards}: "#3, #4") and how many more ({n}).

board.batch.archived.defaultMessage: Archived {n, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}}
board.batch.archived.description: A notification's title after Archive All: how many cards it archived. It has an Undo button.

board.batch.backFailed.defaultMessage: Could not bring the batch back
board.batch.backFailed.description: An error's title: unarchiving a batch of cards failed.

board.batch.broughtBack.defaultMessage: Brought back {n, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}}
board.batch.broughtBack.description: A notification's title: unarchiving a batch brought all its cards back to the board.

board.batch.leftOnBoard.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {One card was} other {# cards were}} left on the board: {why}.
board.batch.leftOnBoard.description: After Archive All, the cards it left on the board (an agent took one meanwhile, one moved): how many, then each card's number and why ({why}, separated by semicolons).

board.batch.noneBack.description: A notification's title: unarchiving a batch brought back none of its cards ({failed}: "#3, #4").

board.batch.nothingArchived.description: A notification's title: Archive All archived no card.

board.batch.otherWorkspace.defaultMessage: This archive is another workspace's: undo it there, from its Archived view
board.batch.otherWorkspace.description: What the notification after Archive All says when its Undo is pressed while the window shows another workspace (HI-2320): nothing was brought back. Archived is the archive's view: use its translation.

board.batch.someBack.defaultMessage: Brought back {n, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}}; {failed} couldn't be
board.batch.someBack.description: A notification's title: unarchiving a batch brought back {n} cards but not the ones listed ({failed}: "#3, #4").

board.batch.stayArchived.defaultMessage: They stay archived with their batch: Unarchive this batch in Archived tries again (a card's file may be open in another program).
board.batch.stayArchived.description: The notification when cards could not be brought back from an archive. "Unarchive this batch" is a button and "Archived" the archive's view: use their translations.

board.batch.undo.description: Button on the notification after Archive All: brings the archived cards back.

board.batchName.allCards.description: An Archive All batch's name in the archived cards' batch picker: every card on the board.

board.batchName.allIn.description: An Archive All batch's name in the archived cards' batch picker: every card of a column ({column}: "Done").

board.batchName.shownCards.description: An Archive All batch's name in the archived cards' batch picker: the {n} cards a search showed on the whole board.

board.batchName.shownIn.description: An Archive All batch's name in the archived cards' batch picker: the {n} cards a search showed in a column ({column}: "Done").

board.busy.assistantWatching.description: Why Archive All skips a card (listed in its dialog): the Combwork Assistant waits for it to change.

board.busy.reviewing.description: Why Archive All skips a card (listed in its dialog): an agent ({agent}, its name) is reviewing it.

board.busy.watching.description: Why Archive All skips a card (listed in its dialog): an agent ({agent}, its name) waits for it to change.

board.busy.watchingUnnamed.description: Why Archive All skips a card (listed in its dialog): an agent (whose name isn't known) waits for it to change.

board.busy.working.description: Why Archive All skips a card (listed in its dialog): an agent ({agent}, its name) is working on it.

board.busy.workingUnnamed.defaultMessage: Its agent is working on it
board.busy.workingUnnamed.description: Why Archive All skips a card (listed in its dialog): its agent (whose name isn't known) is working on it.

board.card.archive.description: Menu item (a card's right-click menu) and button (its dialog): archives the card (off the board, still searchable).

board.card.blocked.description: Accessible name of a folded card's blocked mark (a card that can't go on).

board.card.blockedTip.description: Tooltip on a blocked card: why it can't go on ({reason}, in the user's or an agent's own words).

board.card.bringBack.description: Menu item (a card's right-click menu) and button (its dialog) on an archived card: brings it back to the board.

board.card.collapse.description: Tooltip on the chevron of a card: folds it to one line. {card} is its name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.

board.card.contextBroken.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {Read first no longer resolves: {refs}} other {# Read first references no longer resolve: {refs}}}
board.card.contextBroken.description: A warning on a card (#819): its Read first references (doc sections) that didn't resolve when last checked: how many ({n}) and which ({refs}: references such as "docs/PLAN.md#setup", separated by commas; keep them as they are). The tooltip says why.

board.card.decisionsCount.description: Accessible name of a card's decision count: how many decisions the user recorded about it.

board.card.decisionsTip.description: Tooltip on a card's decision count: how many decisions the user recorded ({n}), then each one, cut short ({decisions}, the user's own words, separated by ·).

board.card.dependsOn.description: Tooltip on a card's dependencies: the cards to finish first ({cards}: "#3, #5").

board.card.expand.description: Tooltip on the chevron of a card folded to one line: shows it in full. {card} is its name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.

board.card.stageInProject.description: Tooltip on a card's project name on the board when its project names the card's stage differently from the column's heading (glossary 2.2: stage). {project} is the project, {stage} its own name for the stage.

board.card.stalled.description: On a stalled card (and its tooltip when folded): nobody is getting on with it, and why ({why}, a sentence).

board.card.stalledMark.description: Accessible name of a folded card's stalled mark (nobody is getting on with it).

board.card.waitingMark.description: Accessible name of a folded card's waiting mark (HI-2618: it waits on purpose).

board.card.waitingTip.defaultMessage: Waiting: {reason} (marked by {by}). Combwork doesn’t report it as stalled meanwhile.
board.card.waitingTip.description: Tooltip on a card in Active that waits on purpose (HI-2618): why ({reason}, in the user's or an agent's own words) and who marked it ({by}: the user ("You"), the Assistant or an agent's name).

board.card.workspace.description: Where a card that belongs to no project is (it is about the whole workspace): shown in place of a project's name on the card. Lower case.

board.cards.count.description: A number of cards ("3 cards"), in Archive All and the archived cards' batch picker.

board.chip.card.description: A card in the hover of an agent's card chip: its name (its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none), title (the user's own words) and how many decisions the user made about it (none: leave that branch empty).

board.chip.clickToOpen.description: The last line of the hover of an agent's card chip. {card} is the card’s name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.

board.chip.doing.description: Heading in the hover of an agent's card chip, above the cards it works on. Active is the board column.

board.chip.open.description: A card chip's accessible name (on an agent's pane or row): opens the card. {card} is its name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.

board.chip.reviewing.description: Heading in the hover of an agent's card chip, above the cards it reviews.

board.clash.message.defaultMessage: Your {fields} replaced the change made meanwhile (see its history).
board.clash.message.description: A warning toast after saving the card dialog: the user's values won over a change made meanwhile. {fields} lists the fields ("title, labels").

board.clash.title.defaultMessage: {card} was also changed while you edited it
board.clash.title.description: A warning toast's title after saving the card dialog: someone (an agent, say) changed the same fields meanwhile. {card} is the card’s name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.

board.column.doing.description: A board column's name: cards being worked on.

board.column.doingDescription.defaultMessage: Being worked on: its agent shows what it is doing now.

board.column.done.description: A board column's name: merged cards.

board.column.doneDescription.defaultMessage: Merged: its builder moves it here after merging (or you do). Archive cards when you no longer need to see them.
board.column.doneDescription.description: The Done column's description (its hover). The builder is the agent that did the card's work.

board.column.hold.description: A board column's name: parked cards nobody picks up until the user moves them on.

board.column.holdDescription.defaultMessage: Parked: nobody picks these up until they move to Todo. Only you and the Assistant put cards here.
board.column.holdDescription.description: The On Hold column's description (its hover). Todo is the column's name; the Assistant is the Combwork Assistant.

board.column.passed.description: A board column's name: cards that passed review and wait to be merged.

board.column.passedDescription.defaultMessage: Its work passed review (or your OK) and waits to be merged. A reviewer moves a card here when it passes.

board.column.review.description: A board column's name: cards whose work is done, waiting for review.

board.column.reviewDescription.defaultMessage: Work done, waiting for its review.

board.column.todo.description: A board column's name: cards ready to start.

board.columns.collapse.description: Tooltip, accessible name and menu item: folds a board column ({column}, its name) sideways into a narrow strip.

board.columns.collapseCards.description: Menu item in a board column's menu: folds each of its cards to one line.

board.columns.emptyTodo.description: In the empty Todo column of the board. + is the button in its header that adds a card.

board.columns.expand.description: Accessible name of a collapsed board column's strip: expands the column ({column}, its name).

board.columns.expandCards.description: Menu item in a board column's menu: shows each of its folded cards in full.

board.columns.expandTip.description: Tooltip on a collapsed board column's strip: expands it. {column} is its name, {description} what the column is for.

board.columns.mergingTip.defaultMessage: Cards in Combwork's merge queue. They come here through the queue once approved, never by a drag; Remove from queue takes one out.
board.columns.mergingTip.description: The Merging column's description (its hover; glossary 2.2: Merging, a stage inside Approved). Remove from queue is the button on the card's Work section and in the Progress panel.

board.columns.more.description: Tooltip on a board column's ⋯ button: opens its menu. {column} is its name.

board.columns.startLane.description: Menu item in the Todo column's menu: opens Start Lane with the column's cards, in its order (a lane: a builder and a reviewer working through cards in turn). Glossary: lane.

board.conflicts.base.description: A label inside a conflict's text in the card dialog's Work section (HI-1181): the lines both sides started from (git's diff3 base) follow.

board.conflicts.clipped.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# long line shortened} other {# long lines shortened}}
board.conflicts.clipped.description: Under a conflict's text in the card dialog's Work section (HI-1181): {n} of its lines were longer than Combwork keeps, so only their start is shown.

board.conflicts.count.description: Beside a file in conflict in the card dialog's Work section (HI-1181): how many conflict regions git left in it.

board.conflicts.cut.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# line left out} other {# lines left out}}
board.conflicts.cut.description: Inside a conflict's text in the card dialog's Work section (HI-1181): this side has {n} more lines than are shown.

board.conflicts.filesLeft.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# more file in conflict, not read} other {# more files in conflict, not read}}
board.conflicts.filesLeft.description: Under the files in conflict in the card dialog's Work section (HI-1181): git named {n} more conflicting files than Combwork reads for one return.

board.conflicts.line.description: Above a conflict's text in the card dialog's Work section (HI-1181): the line of the file where the conflict starts.

board.conflicts.mayHaveMore.defaultMessage: it may have more, not shown
board.conflicts.mayHaveMore.description: Beside a file in conflict in the card dialog's Work section (HI-1181): Combwork stopped recording its conflicts (it had shown enough), so there may be more than shown.

board.conflicts.more.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# more not shown} other {# more not shown}}
board.conflicts.more.description: Beside a file in conflict in the card dialog's Work section (HI-1181): it has {n} more conflict regions than are shown (an exact count).

board.conflicts.noText.description: Beside a file in conflict in the card dialog's Work section (HI-1181): Combwork read the whole file and git left no conflict markers in it (a conflict over the file itself: deleted, renamed, its mode).

board.conflicts.notRead.defaultMessage: {why, select, link {not read: it is a link} outside {not read: outside the queue's folder} missing {not read: not a file there} binary {not read: not text (binary)} notText {not read: not UTF-8 text} budget {not read: past how much Combwork reads} other {not read: it couldn't be read}}
board.conflicts.notRead.description: Beside a file in conflict in the card dialog's Work section (HI-1181): Combwork didn't read its text, and why (select: translate each): a link it never follows, a path outside the merge queue's folder, not a file there (deleted on one side), binary, not UTF-8 text, past the amount Combwork reads for one return, or an error.

board.conflicts.readInPart.defaultMessage: read in part: it may have more
board.conflicts.readInPart.description: Beside a file in conflict in the card dialog's Work section (HI-1181): it is large, so Combwork read only its start; there may be more conflicts than shown.

board.context.close.description: Button: closes the doc section viewer.

board.context.loading.description: The doc section viewer while it reads the section.

board.context.open.description: Button in the doc section viewer (a card's Read first reference, #818): opens the project's file in the Files tab, at the section.

board.context.openNote.description: Button in the doc section viewer (a card's Read first reference to a shared note, #818): opens the note in the Shared Notes view.

board.context.problem.defaultMessage: {why, select, noHeading {That heading isn't in the file} ambiguous {Several headings have that heading's text, so the reference may mean another} notFound {The file isn't there} notMarkdown {It isn't a Markdown file} invalid {It isn't a doc section (a Markdown file, optionally with # and a heading's slug)} tooBig {The file is too big to read} other {It can't be read here}}.{closest, select, none {} other { {why, select, ambiguous {They are} other {Closest headings}}: {closest}.}}
board.context.problem.description: Why a card's Read first reference doesn't lead to a section (#818, #819; the section viewer, the card dialog, a card's tooltip): why ({why}, select: translate each; ambiguous: two headings now have the same text) and the closest headings' slugs, or for ambiguous the headings with that text ({closest}; none: leave that branch empty).

board.cost.cardLine.defaultMessage: cost: {cost}{rounds, plural, =0 {} one { · # round} other { · # rounds}}
board.cost.cardLine.description: A card's cost on the board, under its title: what its agents used ({cost}: "≈ $1.84", "Unknown"), then how many review rounds it has had (none: leave that branch empty). Lower case: it reads as a note.

board.cost.nothingUsed.description: A card's or lane's token use, in a cost hover: no tokens at all. Lower case: it follows a cost.

board.cost.perFinished.defaultMessage: {estimated, select, yes {≈ } other {}}{cost}{unpriced, select, yes { + ?} other {}} a finished card
board.cost.perFinished.description: A lane's cost per finished card ({cost}: "$2.10"), in its cost hover (Progress panel): ≈ first when it is an estimate, + ? when some usage couldn't be priced.

board.cost.tokens.defaultMessage: {estimated, select, yes {≈ } other {}}in {input} · out {output} · cache write {cacheWrite} · cache read {cacheRead}{unknown, select, yes { + unknown} other {}}{requests, plural, =0 {} one { · # request} other { · # requests}}

Lower case: it follows a cost.

board.cost.tokensUnknown.defaultMessage: tokens unknown{requests, plural, =0 {} one { · # request} other { · # requests}}
board.cost.tokensUnknown.description: A card's or lane's token use, in a cost hover: the provider didn't say how many tokens, then how many requests (none: leave that branch empty). Lower case: it follows a cost.

board.costs.builder.description: In a card's cost hover, before what the agent that built it used; and a column of its cost-by-round table (card dialog, Work section). Keep it short.

board.costs.byRound.description: A heading in the card dialog's Work section, above a table of what the card cost in each review round, its builder's and reviewers' parts apart.

board.costs.byRoundFailed.defaultMessage: Its cost by round couldn’t be worked out.
board.costs.byRoundFailed.description: The card dialog's Work section, in place of the cost-by-round table, when Combwork couldn't work it out.

board.costs.byRoundHourly.defaultMessage: Rounds from more than {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago may be split to the hour: Combwork keeps older sessions’ use in 1-hour steps.
board.costs.byRoundHourly.description: Under the card's cost-by-round table (card dialog, Work section), when a round ended before Settings → Advanced's days of full detail: such a round's split may be only to the hour.

board.costs.byRoundNote.defaultMessage: Each role’s cost is shared between its rounds by when its agents used it (≈); the rows and columns add up to the card’s cost.
board.costs.byRoundNote.description: Under the card's cost-by-round table (card dialog, Work section): how the split is made. Keep ≈.

board.costs.cost.description: A lane's cost hover (Progress panel), before what its agents used in all. Keep it short.

board.costs.laneFailed.defaultMessage: Its cost couldn’t be worked out.
board.costs.laneFailed.description: A lane's cost hover (Progress panel) when Combwork couldn't work the cost out.

board.costs.laneLoading.description: A lane's cost hover (Progress panel) while Combwork works the cost out.

board.costs.note.defaultMessage: What its agents used while they held it, as the providers reported it: ≈ is Combwork’s estimate, ? or Unknown what isn’t known (never {zero}).
board.costs.note.description: Under a card's cost breakdown (its hover): what the cost is. ≈, ? and Unknown are how costs show: keep ≈ and ?, and use the same word for Unknown as the costs do. {zero} is no cost, as costs show it ("$0.00").

board.costs.onCards.description: A lane's cost hover (Progress panel), before what its agents used while holding a card. Keep it short.

board.costs.outsideRow.description: A row of the card's cost-by-round table (card dialog, Work section): what its agents used holding it before its work began under 1.0's rules (a card taken on at the upgrade). Keep it short.

board.costs.overhead.description: A lane's cost hover (Progress panel), before what its agents used holding no card (merges, watching). Keep it short.

board.costs.overheadNote.defaultMessage: Overhead: what the builder and reviewer used holding no card (merges, watching, compactions). ≈ is Combwork’s estimate; ? or Unknown what isn’t known.
board.costs.overheadNote.description: Under a lane's cost breakdown (its hover, Progress panel): what Overhead is. Use the same word for Overhead as above it, and for Unknown as the costs do; keep ≈ and ?.

board.costs.reviewer.description: In a card's cost hover, before what the agent that reviewed it used; and a column of its cost-by-round table (card dialog, Work section). Keep it short.

board.costs.roundColumn.description: The card's cost-by-round table (card dialog, Work section): the heading of its first column, naming each row's round. Keep it short.

board.costs.roundRow.description: A row of the card's cost-by-round table (card dialog, Work section): one review round (1, 2…).

board.costs.roundVerdict.defaultMessage: {verdict, select, passed {Passed} failed {Failed} other {Not reviewed yet}}
board.costs.roundVerdict.description: Hover of a round in the card's cost-by-round table (card dialog, Work section): how its review ended, passed or failed, or not reviewed yet. Keep the select keys.

board.costs.totalColumn.description: The card's cost-by-round table (card dialog, Work section): the last row and column, what each round, role and the whole card cost. Keep it short.

board.costs.unmatched.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {One agent that held it has} other {# agents that held it have}} no session Combwork knows of: unknown.
board.costs.unmatched.description: In a card's cost hover: some agents that held the card have no session Combwork knows of, so what they used is unknown.

board.decision.add.description: Button in the card dialog: records the decision written above.

board.decision.blank.defaultMessage: A decision can't be empty: write it again, cancel the change, or remove the decision with its bin.
board.decision.blank.description: An error in the card dialog: Save with a decision changed to nothing. The bin is the button that removes a decision.

board.decision.by.description: Under a decision in the card dialog: the user decided it (and recorded it).

board.decision.byRecorded.description: Under a decision in the card dialog: the user decided it, and an agent or the Assistant wrote it down ({recorder}, its name).

board.decision.change.description: Tooltip on the pencil button beside a decision (card dialog).

board.decision.editLabel.description: Accessible name of the box where a decision is changed (card dialog).

board.decision.edited.description: Under a decision in the card dialog, after when it was decided: it was changed since. Lower case.

board.decision.heading.description: A heading in the card dialog: the decisions the user recorded about the card, and how many ({n}).

board.decision.info.defaultMessage: What you decided about this card: scope, wording, a default. Agents read them when they start and again before Review, and follow them where the description says otherwise; reviewers check the work against them. An agent or the Assistant can write down a decision you made; only you change or remove one.
board.decision.info.description: The (i) beside the card dialog's Decisions heading. Review is the board column; the Assistant is the Combwork Assistant.

board.decision.new.description: A badge on a decision in the card dialog: it was recorded after work on the card began. Lower case, short.

board.decision.newLabel.description: Accessible name of the box where a new decision is written (card dialog).

board.decision.newPlaceholder.defaultMessage: Record a decision you made about this card (agents follow it over the description)
board.decision.newPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the box where a new decision is written (card dialog).

board.decision.remove.description: Button: removes the decision from the card.

board.decision.removeMessage.defaultMessage: "{decision}" leaves {card}. Its history keeps what it said.
board.decision.removeMessage.description: The confirmation before a decision is removed: {decision} is its text (cut short), {card} the card’s name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.

board.decision.removeTip.description: Tooltip on the bin button beside a decision (card dialog).

board.decision.removeTitle.description: Title of the confirmation before a card's decision is removed.

board.decision.removing.description: The Remove button while the decision is being removed.

board.decision.saveAddsIt.description: Beside Add Decision once something is written: the card dialog's Save button adds the decision as well.

board.delete.busy.description: The Delete button while the card is being deleted.

board.delete.button.description: Button: deletes the card (to the Recycle Bin).

board.delete.message.defaultMessage: "{title}" goes to the Recycle Bin, with its comments and history. Archive it instead to keep it out of sight but searchable.
board.delete.message.description: The confirmation before a card is deleted. {title} is the card's title. Recycle Bin is Windows' name for it.

board.delete.title.description: Title of the confirmation before a card is deleted. {card} is its name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.

board.details.agent.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel): the agent that ran it (and its project) follows.

board.details.card.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel): the card it ran for follows (#1061).

board.details.check.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel): whether it counts as a check of its card follows.

board.details.command.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel): the command it ran follows.

board.details.copy.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel): the name of the review or check copy it ran in follows (copy-1): a folder Combwork keeps at exactly the card's revision, which nothing else writes.

board.details.countsAsCheck.description: A run's details in the Progress panel: the run counts as the card's check named {name} ("typecheck", as the project names it).

board.details.ended.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel): a date and time follows.

board.details.exitCode.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel): its command's exit code follows (a number).

board.details.folder.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel): the folder it ran in follows (a path), as it was when it ran.

board.details.gone.defaultMessage: Ended without a report: its process ended before it said how it went
board.details.gone.description: A run's state in its details (Progress panel): its process ended without reporting.

board.details.install.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel), on one of the merge queue's checks: what was installed before it follows.

board.details.installAsWritten.defaultMessage: The setup command as written, after removing node_modules: Combwork has no clean form of it
board.details.installAsWritten.description: A run's details in the Progress panel, on the merge queue's install: Combwork ran the project's worktree setup command as it is written (it is not a package manager's plain install, such as npm install, that Combwork knows how to run clean), after deleting the queue folder's node_modules so the install starts from scratch.

board.details.interrupted.description: A run's state in its details (Progress panel): its command was interrupted.

board.details.lastStep.description: A run's details in the Progress panel, its steps: the last step reported ({step}, as the reporter named it), with no count.

board.details.line.description: A line of a run's details copied as text (Copy details, Progress panel): a label ("Command") and its text.

board.details.log.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel): the path of its log file follows.

board.details.noInstall.defaultMessage: Nothing installed: the project has no setup command and no lock file
board.details.noInstall.description: A run's details in the Progress panel, on one of the merge queue's checks: Combwork installed nothing before the checks, because the project has neither a worktree setup command (Project Settings → Agents) nor a package lock file.

board.details.notCounted.defaultMessage: Doesn't count as check {name}: {why, select, notCheck {it wasn't started as a check (cw-progress --check), and its command isn't one the project has for a check} notContained {what was checked out doesn't contain the card's revision} dirty {the folder had uncommitted changes when it started or ended} moved {something else was checked out when it ended} changed {files changed in the folder while it ran} revisionChanged {the card's files changed while it ran} other {it can't be told whether its files changed}}
board.details.notCounted.description: A run's details in the Progress panel: why the run doesn't count as the card's check named {name} ("typecheck", or the run's title when it wasn't a check). {why} picks the reason: keep each branch's key as it is.

board.details.provider.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel): the agent's CLI follows (Claude Code, Codex…).

board.details.revision.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel): the card's revision follows, the version of the card's work the run was for: a commit id, or for a project with no platform a hash of the card's files' content (not a commit).

board.details.run.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel): the run's title follows.

board.details.staleAgentStopped.defaultMessage: Stopped reporting: its agent stopped before it finished
board.details.staleAgentStopped.description: A run's state in its details (Progress panel): the agent that ran it stopped first.

board.details.staleQuiet.description: A run's state in its details (Progress panel): no news from it for {quiet} ("12 min").

board.details.started.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel): a date and time follows.

board.details.state.defaultMessage: {state, select, running {Running} failed {Failed} passed {Passed} other {Stopped}}{dismissed, select, yes { (dismissed)} other {}}
board.details.state.description: A run's state in its details (Progress panel): running, failed or passed; then " (dismissed)" when the user dismissed the run.

board.details.stateLabel.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel): its state follows (Running, Failed…).

board.details.steps.description: A run's details in the Progress panel, its steps: {done} of {total} steps done.

board.details.stepsLabel.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel): its steps follow ("4 of 12 done").

board.details.stepsLast.description: A run's details in the Progress panel, its steps: {done} of {total} steps done, and the last step reported ({step}, as the reporter named it).

board.details.summary.description: A label in a run's details copied as text (Copy details, Progress panel): the summary its reporter gave follows.

board.details.temporary.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel), on one of the merge queue's failed checks: why the failure counts as temporary (the environment's, not the work's) follows.

board.details.testedOn.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel), shown when it differs from the card's revision: the commit that was checked out where the run ran follows (a commit id).

board.details.took.description: A label in a run's details (Progress panel): how long it ran follows.

board.details.tookSoFar.defaultMessage: {took} so far{expected, select, none {} other { · expected about {expected}}}
board.details.tookSoFar.description: How long a run that is still going has run, in its details (Progress panel): {took} ("4 min"), then about how long runs like it take ({expected}, a duration, or none when unknown: keep that branch empty).

board.details.tookTotal.description: How long a finished run took, in its details (Progress panel): {took} ("4 min"), then about how long runs like it take ({expected}, a duration, or none when unknown: keep that branch empty).

board.details.transient.defaultMessage: {cause, select, spawn {It couldn't start} notFound {Its program wasn't found} timeout {It ran out of time} killed {It was ended from outside} exit75 {It exited with code 75, the project's “temporary failure, try again”} other {A network error in its last lines ({code})}}: the card was returned to its builder, who may submit the same revision again (at most twice in a row) instead of a new one.
board.details.transient.description: A run's details in the Progress panel: why a failed merge check counts as temporary, picked by {cause} (keep each branch's key as it is); {code} is the network error code found in its output (ENOTFOUND, ECONNRESET…: keep it as it is). Code 75 is a number: keep it.

board.details.waitingSince.description: A run's state in its details (Progress panel): waiting since a date and time ({since}) for what its reporter says ({waiting}, in its own words: "a test slot").

board.dialog.activity.description: A button in the card dialog and an item of a card's right-click menu, for a card in Doing or Review: opens its project's Activity tab on the agent working on it, showing what runs on it now.

board.dialog.activityTip.defaultMessage: See what runs on this card now: the turn, tool calls, background tasks, subagents and processes of the agent working on it.
board.dialog.activityTip.description: Tooltip of the card dialog's Activity button, and the detail of the card menu's Activity item.

board.dialog.addCard.description: The New Card dialog's main button: adds the card.

board.dialog.added.defaultMessage: {who, select, you {Added by you} assistant {Added by the Assistant} repair {Added by Repair} other {Added by {by}}} {added} · changed {changed}
board.dialog.added.description: At the foot of the card dialog: who added the card ({who}: you, the user; assistant, the Combwork Assistant; repair, Combwork's Repair, which gives cards back to a moved project; other: an agent, {by} its name), when ({added}: "3 days ago"), and when it last changed ({changed}).

board.dialog.addedUnknown.description: At the foot of the card dialog when who added the card isn't known: when it was added ({added}: "3 days ago") and last changed ({changed}).

board.dialog.adding.description: A button while a new card or decision is being added.

board.dialog.agent.description: A field label in the card dialog: the agent the card is given to.

board.dialog.agentStatus.description: An agent in the card dialog's agent choice, with what it is doing ({status}: "Working…").

board.dialog.archivedBanner.defaultMessage: {cause, select, hidden {Archived when {project} was hidden.} removed {Archived when {project} was removed from Combwork.} done {Archived automatically after its days in Done (Settings → Board).} other {Archived.}} Bring it back to change it.
board.dialog.archivedBanner.description: A banner in an archived card's dialog: why it was archived (its project {project} hidden or removed, or after its days in the Done column: Settings → Board is where that is set), and that it must be brought back to be changed.

board.dialog.archiving.description: A button while cards are being archived.

board.dialog.blocked.description: A field label in the card dialog: why the card can't go on (empty: it isn't blocked).

board.dialog.blockedPlaceholder.defaultMessage: Why it can't go on (empty: not blocked)
board.dialog.blockedPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the card dialog's Blocked box: why the card can't go on; empty means it isn't blocked.

board.dialog.bringingBack.description: The Bring Back button while the archived card is being brought back.

board.dialog.cancel.description: Button: closes a board dialog without doing anything.

board.dialog.column.description: A field label in the card dialog: the board column the card is in.

board.dialog.commentPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the card dialog's comment box.

board.dialog.comments.description: A heading in the card dialog: the card's comments, and how many ({n}).

board.dialog.context.description: A field label in the card dialog (#818): doc sections the card's agent reads before starting, given in its start prompt.

board.dialog.contextPlaceholder.defaultMessage: Doc sections, one a line: docs/PLAN.md#setup, shared:plans/notes.md#open-questions
board.dialog.contextPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the card dialog's Read first box (#818): references to doc sections, one a line (keep the examples as they are).

board.dialog.creatingWorktree.description: A button while a card is being started on a new agent in its own git worktree (making the worktree takes a moment).

board.dialog.delete.description: Button in the card dialog: deletes the card (after asking).

board.dialog.dependsOn.description: A field label in the card dialog: the cards to finish before this one.

board.dialog.dependsOnPlaceholder.defaultMessage: Cards to finish first, e.g. AM-3 AM-5
board.dialog.dependsOnPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the card dialog's Depends on box: cards by name (AM-3 AM-5 are examples: a project key, a hyphen and a number; #3 works too).

board.dialog.description.description: A heading in the card dialog: the card's description.

board.dialog.newComment.description: Accessible name of the box where a comment is written (card dialog).

board.dialog.noProject.description: The card dialog's project choice for a card of no project: it is about the whole workspace.

board.dialog.posting.description: The Comment button while the comment is being posted.

board.dialog.related.description: A field label in the card dialog: related cards.

board.dialog.relatedPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the card dialog's Related box: cards by name (AM-7 is an example: a project key, a hyphen and a number).

board.dialog.saveAndStart.description: Button in the card dialog with unsaved changes: saves them, then asks which agent starts the card.

board.dialog.savePostsIt.description: Beside the Comment button once something is written: the card dialog's Save button posts the comment as well.

board.dialog.saving.description: A button while the card (or a decision) is being saved.

board.dialog.start.description: Button in the card dialog: asks which agent starts the card.

board.dialog.startButton.description: Button of the Start dialog (and of Move to Doing with Assign and start): starts the card on the chosen agent.

board.dialog.startTip.defaultMessage: Give it to an agent, with the card as its prompt.

board.dialog.startTipSave.description: Tooltip on the card dialog's Save and Start… button.

board.dialog.starting.description: A button while a card is being started on an agent.

board.dialog.titlePlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the card dialog's title box.

board.dialog.tryAgain.description: A board dialog's main button after it failed: does it again.

board.dialog.write.description: A tab button in the card dialog: edit the description's Markdown.

board.discard.changes.description: What closing the card dialog would lose, in "Closing loses {what}.": changed fields. Lower case.

board.duration.seconds.description: A short duration in seconds ("40 s"), in the Progress panel and on cards. Keep it short: an abbreviation.

board.error.stopAgentsFirst.description: An error from Help → Restore the 0.9 Board Backup…: agents of the workspace are running or starting; the board put back is read-only in this Combwork, so their sessions couldn't be recorded. Nothing was changed.

board.error.unarchive.defaultMessage: Could not bring the card back
board.error.unarchive.description: An error toast's title: bringing an archived card back to the board failed.

board.error.unavailable.description: An error: the workspace's task board database couldn't be opened or its cards couldn't be moved into it; {error} says why (from the system, often in English). Nothing was lost: the cards are still where they were.

board.error.upgradeFirst.defaultMessage: This board is from version 0.9: it is read-only until it is upgraded to 1.0 (Upgrade… on the board's banner).
board.error.upgradeFirst.description: An error: the workspace's task board hasn't been upgraded to 1.0's format yet (the user was asked and said not now), so cards can be read but not changed. Upgrade… is the button on the banner above the board.

board.error.upgradeFirstStart.defaultMessage: This workspace is from version 0.9: upgrade it to 1.0 before starting agents (Upgrade… on the banner at the top of the window).
board.error.upgradeFirstStart.description: An error: an agent (or the Assistant) can't start while the workspace's data waits for its upgrade to 1.0's format (the user said Not Now): Combwork couldn't record its session. Upgrade… is the button on the banner at the top of the window.

board.export.command.description: A command (the board's ⋯ menu, the command palette): saves every card of the board as a JSON file, in a new folder inside one the user picks. The … says it asks first: keep it.

board.export.done.defaultMessage: Exported {n, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}}
board.export.done.description: A notification after Export Board to JSON: how many cards were saved.

board.export.failed.description: A notification: Export Board to JSON failed (why follows).

board.field.agent.description: A card's field, named in a list ("Your agent replaced the change made meanwhile"). Lower case.

board.field.blocked.description: A card's field, named in a list ("Your blocked replaced the change made meanwhile"): why it can't go on. Lower case.

board.field.blockedBy.description: A card's field, named in a list ("Your dependencies replaced the change made meanwhile"): the cards it depends on (the dialog's Depends on). Lower case.

board.field.column.description: A card's field, named in a list ("Your column replaced the change made meanwhile"): the board column it is in. Lower case.

board.field.context.description: A card's field, named in a list ("Your doc sections to read first replaced the change made meanwhile"): its Read first references. Lower case.

board.field.description.description: A card's field, named in a list ("Your title, description replaced the change made meanwhile"). Lower case.

board.field.labels.description: A card's field, named in a list ("Your labels replaced the change made meanwhile"). Lower case.

board.field.links.description: A card's field, named in a list ("Your links replaced the change made meanwhile"): its related cards. Lower case.

board.field.project.description: A card's field, named in a list ("Your project replaced the change made meanwhile"). Lower case.

board.field.title.description: A card's field, named in a list ("Your title, labels replaced the change made meanwhile"). Lower case.

board.filter.noProject.description: A choice of the Progress panel's project filter: the runs of the Combwork Assistant and of scripts, which belong to no project.

board.forYou.agree.defaultMessage: {action, select, done {Move to Done With This Reply} noCode {Make It No Code With This Reply} skipReview {Skip Review With This Reply} other {Unblock With This Reply}}
board.forYou.agree.description: A button under an agent's question for the user (For you), beside Send, when the question offers one action: does that action as the user, with the reply typed in the box as its reason, and answers the question. Keep the select keys as they are; translate each choice.

board.forYou.agreeTip.defaultMessage: Does what the agent asked as you, with your reply as the reason, and answers the question. Send only answers it: Combwork never reads a yes into a reply.
board.forYou.agreeTip.description: Tooltip of the button under an agent's question (For you) that does the action the question offers with the user's reply as its reason. Send is the button that only sends the reply.

board.forYou.answering.description: A button while the user's answer to a request is being recorded.

board.forYou.approve.description: A button under a request for the user's approval (For you): approves it. Glossary: approve.

board.forYou.asDecision.description: A button under a question for the user (For you): records the answer typed above as one of the card's decisions (a new decision, which its agents read), and answers the question with it.

board.forYou.asDecisionTip.defaultMessage: Records your answer as one of the card's decisions, which its agents must follow from now on, and answers the question with it.
board.forYou.asDecisionTip.description: Tooltip of the Record as Decision button under a question for the user (For you): what it does. Glossary: decision.

board.forYou.asked.description: Under a request for the user in the card dialog: who asks (Combwork, or an agent: its name {who}) and when ({when}: "5 min ago"). Keep the select keys as they are.

board.forYou.checklist.description: Above the checklist of a Test request (For you): what the user is asked to try.

board.forYou.chip.description: A chip on a board card: something on the card waits for the user (an approval, a decision, a question). Glossary: For you.

board.forYou.chipTip.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {Waits for you: {requests}} other {# requests wait for you: {requests}}}
board.forYou.chipTip.description: Accessible name of a card's For you chip: how many requests wait for the user ({n}) and each one, its kind and the start of what it asks ({requests}, separated by · ). Glossary: For you.

board.forYou.decline.description: A button under a request for the user's approval (For you): declines it, asking why first (…). For the user's review, the card goes back to its builder as a round.

board.forYou.declineNeeds.defaultMessage: Say why, so the agent knows what to change.
board.forYou.declineNeeds.description: An error in the question when the user declines a request without a reason: one is needed.

board.forYou.declineTitle.description: Title of the question when the user declines a request (For you); {request} is what it asks.

board.forYou.declineWhy.defaultMessage: Why? The agent waiting on it reads your reason.
board.forYou.declineWhy.description: The question when the user declines a request for their approval: their reason, which the waiting agent is told.

board.forYou.failed.description: An error toast's title: the user's answer to a request (For you) was refused, perhaps answered or retired meanwhile (a new submission, the card moved on). Its text says why.

board.forYou.heading.description: A heading in the card dialog, above what on the card waits for the user (approvals, decisions, questions). Glossary: For you.

board.forYou.offer.defaultMessage: {action, select, done {Move to Done} noCode {Make It No Code} skipReview {Skip Review} other {Unblock}}
board.forYou.offer.description: A button under an agent's question for the user (For you): an action the agent offers on its card, done with one click. Keep the select keys as they are; translate each choice.

board.forYou.offerReason.description: The label (and placeholder) of the field beside an action an agent's question offers (For you): why the user does it, filled with the agent's suggestion; it is recorded with the action.

board.forYou.offerTip.defaultMessage: {action, select, done {Moves the card to Done as you, skipping its project's rules where needed (recorded as an override, with the reason beside it), and answers the question.} noCode {Makes the card no code as you (recorded as an override, with the reason beside it), and answers the question.} skipReview {Skips the card's review as you (with the reason beside it), and answers the question.} other {Unblocks the card (the reason beside it is added as your comment), and answers the question.}}
board.forYou.offerTip.description: Tooltip of a button under an agent's question for the user (For you): what the action the agent offers does. Keep the select keys as they are. Glossary: override, no-code card.

board.forYou.reply.description: The label (and placeholder) of the box under a question for the user (For you) in the card dialog: the user's answer, sent to the agent that asked.

board.forYou.resolvedBy.defaultMessage: {gone, select, yes {By a decision since removed} other {By your decision: “{decision}”}}, {who, select, you {recorded by you} assistant {recorded by the Assistant} other {recorded by {name}}}
board.forYou.resolvedBy.description: Under a request in the card dialog's For you section answered by a decision (HI-1932): the user's decision that answered it ({decision}: its words, cut short; gone yes: the user has removed that decision from the card since), and who wrote the decision down: the user, the Combwork Assistant (recording the user's own words), or another ({name}). Keep the select keys.

board.forYou.resolvedHeading.description: A heading in the card dialog's For you section (HI-1932): the requests that waited for the user (questions) and were answered by a decision the user made, recorded on the card. Glossary: For you, decision.

board.forYou.rounds.description: The label of the number box beside Carry on, at a card loop's round limit: how many more review rounds the card gets.

board.forYou.saveAndMerge.description: A button under the merge queue's question before an upgraded project's first merge (HI-1697, For you): saves the merge style and commit message chosen above as the project's workflow options, and the merge queue carries on.

board.forYou.send.description: A button under a question for the user (For you): sends the answer typed above to the agent that asked.

board.forYou.sendTip.defaultMessage: Sends your answer to the agent that asked, and adds it to the card as your comment.
board.forYou.sendTip.description: Tooltip of the Send Reply button under a question for the user (For you): what it does.

board.forYou.showAll.description: A button under a long request for the user (For you) in the card dialog, shown only partly: shows all of it, or (yes) folds it again.

board.forYou.showStuck.description: A button on a For you request about a merge that stopped part way: shows the card's Work section, where each file and the commands that finish or undo the merge are listed.

board.forYou.tipAsks.defaultMessage: {kind, select, approve {{who} asks for your OK} decide {{who} asks you to decide} test {{who} asks you to test} signIn {{who} asks you to sign in} other {{who} asks you}}
board.forYou.tipAsks.description: The first line of a request in the tooltip of a card's For you chip: who asks ({who}: an agent's name, or Combwork) and what for (the request's kind: approve, decide, test, sign in, or anything else). The start of the request follows on the next line. Keep the select keys as they are. Glossary: For you.

board.forYou.tipMore.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {and # more request} other {and # more requests}}
board.forYou.tipMore.description: In the tooltip of a card's For you chip, after the first requests shown: how many more wait for the user ({n}).

board.forYou.tipOpen.defaultMessage: Click to open the card and answer under For you.
board.forYou.tipOpen.description: The last line of the tooltip of a card's For you chip: a click opens the card, whose For you section shows each request in full with its answers. Glossary: For you.

board.forYou.todayValue.description: A choice in the merge queue's question before an upgraded project's first merge (HI-1697, For you): a value of a workflow option ({value}), marked when it is how Combwork merged until now. Keep the select keys as they are.

board.inbox.asks.description: An agent in the attention inbox has asked the user a question.

board.inbox.asksWhat.description: An agent in the attention inbox has asked the user a question ({message}, in the agent's own words).

board.inbox.assistant.description: The Combwork Assistant, named in the attention inbox (status bar popover, tray menu) where a project name goes. Combwork is the app's name: keep it.

board.inbox.cardRequests.description: On a card's row in the For you popover (the status bar's "need you"), when it has several requests for the user (approvals, decisions, questions: all called questions here) or an agent stopped on it: how many requests ({n}). They are listed under it.

board.inbox.changes.description: Button on a worktree agent's row in the inbox: shows its changes in the Git tab.

board.inbox.commits.description: A worktree agent's unmerged commits, in the attention inbox ("2 commits").

board.inbox.diff.description: A worktree agent's unmerged changes, in the attention inbox: how many files differ from its base branch, and the lines added (+) and removed (−).

board.inbox.error.description: An agent in the attention inbox stopped because of an error and waits for the user.

board.inbox.errorWhat.description: An agent in the attention inbox stopped because of an error (an API connection error, say) and waits for the user; {message} is what its CLI said (its own words).

board.inbox.failed.description: An agent in the attention inbox failed to start.

board.inbox.failedWhy.description: An agent in the attention inbox failed to start; {message} is why (an error's first line).

board.inbox.finished.description: An agent in the attention inbox finished its turn and the user has not looked at it since.

board.inbox.finishedCount.description: The status bar's quiet item: how many agents finished their turn since the user last looked ("3 finished"). Keep it short.

board.inbox.finishedHeading.description: Heading in the inbox popover above the agents that finished since the user last looked, with how many ({n}). Not something that waits for the user.

board.inbox.finishedTip.defaultMessage: Agents that finished since you last looked at them. Nothing waits for you there: click to see them.
board.inbox.finishedTip.description: Tooltip of the status bar's quiet item beside "n need you": what it counts (agents that finished their turn, not looked at since).

board.inbox.merge.description: Button on a worktree agent's row in the inbox: opens the merge dialog for its branch.

board.inbox.needYouCount.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# needs you} other {# need you}}
board.inbox.needYouCount.description: The status bar's inbox item: how many things wait for the user, requests on cards and agents stopped in their panes ("2 need you"). Keep it short.

board.inbox.needYouEmptyHeading.description: Heading in the inbox popover above what waits for the user, when nothing does.

board.inbox.needYouHeading.description: Heading in the inbox popover above what waits for the user (requests on cards, agents stopped in their panes), with how many ({n}).

board.inbox.needYouThings.defaultMessage: {agents, plural, =0 {{cards, plural, one {# card needs you} other {# cards need you}}} other {{cards, plural, =0 {{agents, plural, one {# agent needs you} other {# agents need you}}} one {# card and {agents, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} need you} other {# cards and {agents, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} need you}}}}. Click to see them.
board.inbox.needYouThings.description: Tooltip of the status bar's inbox item ("3 need you"): what it counts, as cards with requests for the user (each once, however many requests: approvals, decisions, questions) and agents stopped in their panes (a prompt, a sign-in, a question, an error; one stopped on a counted card isn't counted again). {cards} and {agents} are how many. Glossary: For you.

board.inbox.needsInput.description: An agent in the attention inbox waits for the user's answer.

board.inbox.needsInputWhat.description: An agent in the attention inbox waits for the user's answer; {message} is what its CLI shows (its own words).

board.inbox.nothing.description: The inbox popover when nothing waits for the user.

board.inbox.panel.description: The inbox popover's accessible name (above the status bar): requests on cards and agents waiting for the user, and agents that finished.

board.inbox.safeguard.description: An agent in the attention inbox whose CLI's safety classifier stopped a response.

board.inbox.safeguardSwitched.defaultMessage: After a safeguard stop: Now runs on {to} instead of {from}
board.inbox.safeguardSwitched.description: An agent in the attention inbox whose CLI's safety classifier stopped a response, so it moved to another model: {to} and {from} are the models' names.

board.inbox.signin.description: An agent in the attention inbox waits for the user to sign in to its CLI (its sign-in was refused or has expired).

board.inbox.toReview.description: A worktree agent in the attention inbox has unmerged work for the user to review.

board.inbox.toReviewCount.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# to review} other {# to review}}
board.inbox.toReviewCount.description: The status bar's inbox item: how many worktree agents have work for the user to review ("1 to review"). Keep it short.

board.inbox.toReviewHeading.description: Heading in the inbox popover above worktree agents whose work waits for the user's review, with how many ({n}).

board.inbox.toReviewTip.defaultMessage: Worktree agents with work to review
board.inbox.toReviewTip.description: Tooltip of the status bar's inbox item when only worktree agents' work waits ("1 to review").

board.inbox.uncommitted.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# uncommitted file} other {# uncommitted files}}
board.inbox.uncommitted.description: A worktree agent's files with changes not committed yet, in the attention inbox ("1 uncommitted file").

board.kind.anyway.description: The button of the question before a card's kind is changed: makes the change, recorded as an override (glossary: override).

board.kind.askDetail.defaultMessage: Changing it anyway records an override on the card, with your reason.
board.kind.askDetail.description: Under the rule a kind change skips, in the question before it: the change is recorded on the card as an exception to the rules (glossary: override), with the reason the user gives below.

board.kind.askMessage.defaultMessage: This skips a rule of its project:
board.kind.askMessage.description: The question before a card's kind is changed after it was made: the rule it skips is listed below (its name).

board.kind.askTitle.defaultMessage: {kind, select, code {Make {card} code?} other {Make {card} no code?}}
board.kind.askTitle.description: Title of the question before a card's kind is changed after it was made. {kind} is the kind it would get (select keys), {card} the card's name.

board.kind.change.defaultMessage: {kind, select, code {Make It No Code…} other {Make It Code…}}
board.kind.change.description: A button beside a card's kind in its dialog: changes it to the other kind, asking first (…): an exception to the card's rules. Select keys: the kind it is now.

board.kind.code.description: A card's kind in its dialog: work in commits (the default). Glossary: no-code card.

board.kind.confirm.description: A button on the banner of a card an agent proposed as no code: makes it no code.

board.kind.failed.description: An error toast's title: changing or confirming a card's kind failed. Its text says why.

board.kind.field.description: A field label in the card dialog: the card's kind, code (work in commits) or no code (a decision, a write-up, a trial). Glossary: no-code card.

board.kind.keep.description: A button on the banner of a card an agent proposed as no code: keeps it code (work in commits).

board.kind.newChoice.defaultMessage: No code (a decision, a write-up, a trial…)
board.kind.newChoice.description: A tick box in the New Card dialog: the card's work has no commits; it is submitted with a summary. Glossary: no-code card.

board.kind.noCode.description: A card's kind (a mark on its tile, and in its dialog): work with no commits, such as a decision, a write-up or a trial; it is submitted with a summary. Glossary: no-code card.

board.kind.noCodeTip.defaultMessage: No code: its work is a decision, a write-up or a trial, submitted with a summary and no commits.
board.kind.noCodeTip.description: Tooltip and accessible name of a card's No code mark (on its tile). Glossary: no-code card.

board.kind.proposal.defaultMessage: No code? The agent that made this card proposes it: its work has no commits (a decision, a write-up, a trial).
board.kind.proposal.description: A banner in a card's dialog: the agent that made the card proposed it as no code, and the user is to confirm it or keep it as code. Glossary: no-code card.

board.kind.proposedTip.defaultMessage: No code? Proposed by the agent that made it: open the card to confirm it.
board.kind.proposedTip.description: Tooltip and accessible name of a card's mark when an agent proposed it as no code (no commits) and nobody has answered yet. Glossary: no-code card.

board.kind.reason.description: The label of the field in the question before a card's kind is changed: why the user makes the exception. Optional.

board.kind.working.description: A button while the card's kind is being saved.

board.lane.afterRound.description: Where a lane's finished card is, in its segment's label (Progress panel): its column ({where}, "Passed" or "Done") and the review round it passed in ({round}, a number above 1).

board.lane.andMore.description: The last item of a folded lane segment's list of cards (Progress panel), after the first eight card numbers: how many more there are ({n}). Combwork joins it to the list ("#1, #2 … #8 and 3 more").

board.lane.blocked.description: A lane segment's note in the Progress panel (its hover): the card is blocked, with no reason given. {card} is its name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.

board.lane.blockedReason.description: A lane segment's note in the Progress panel (its hover): the card is blocked, and why, in the user's or an agent's own words ({reason}). {card} is its name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.

board.lane.finished.description: A lane segment's label (Progress panel) for its finished cards folded into one: how many ({n}) and which ({cards}: "#3, #4").

board.lane.foldedMark.description: A line in the hover of a lane segment that folds several cards ("✓ 6", "+4", Progress panel): one card's mark. {card} is its name (its key, such as AL-12), {mark} what the mark says, a sentence already translated (a refusal, a stale pass, a move past its rules).

board.lane.goneWhenEnded.defaultMessage: {card} · not on the board when the lane ended
board.lane.goneWhenEnded.description: A lane segment's label (Progress panel), in a lane that has ended: the card wasn't on the board then. {card} is its name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.

board.lane.holdReason.description: A lane segment's note in the Progress panel (its hover): the card is On Hold (a board column), and why, in the user's own words ({reason}). {card} is its name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.

board.lane.holdWaiting.defaultMessage: {card}: On Hold: waiting for you to move it on
board.lane.holdWaiting.description: A lane segment's note in the Progress panel (its hover): the card is On Hold (a board column) until the user moves it. {card} is its name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.

board.lane.holdWaitingShort.description: Where a lane's card is, in its segment's label (Progress panel): On Hold (a board column) until the user moves it on.

board.lane.inRound.description: Where a lane's card is, in its segment's label (Progress panel): its column ({where}, "Doing" or "Review") and the review round it is in ({round}, a number).

board.lane.label.description: A lane segment's label (Progress panel): the card’s name (its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none), title (the user's own words) and where it is ({where}: "Review, round 2").

board.lane.labelWhenEnded.description: A lane segment's label (Progress panel), in a lane that has ended: the card’s name (its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none), title (the user's own words) and where it was then ({where}: "Review, round 2").

board.lane.more.description: A lane segment's label (Progress panel) for the cards that don't fit its bar, folded into one: how many ({n}) and which ({cards}: "#3, #4").

board.lane.notOnBoard.description: A lane segment's label (Progress panel) for a card that isn't on the board (archived or deleted). {card} is its name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.

board.lane.oldRules.defaultMessage: Old rules: this card started under the workflow options from before they changed, and keeps them until it’s Done.{enforced, select, no { Workflow rules aren’t enforced now.} other {}}
board.lane.oldRules.description: A line in a lane segment's hover and accessible name (Progress panel), with its old rules mark: the card's project's workflow options changed while it was in flight, and it keeps the ones it started with until it is Done (unless they are applied to it). enforced no: the switch "Workflow rules are enforced" is off. Keep the select keys. Glossary: workflow options.

board.lane.openForMore.defaultMessage: Click to open the card for the rest
board.lane.openForMore.description: The last line of a lane segment's hover (Progress panel), under what its facts say: clicking the segment opens the card, which shows everything.

board.lane.reviewFailed.description: A lane segment's note in the Progress panel (its hover, under a red underline): the card's review round {round} failed and the next round ({next}) hasn't started. {card} is its name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.
