board.lane.reviewerGist.description: A lane segment's note in the Progress panel: the first line of the reviewer's failed verdict ({gist}, in the reviewer's own words).

board.lane.roundFailed.description: Where a lane's card is, in its segment's label (Progress panel): its column ({where}, "Review"), and that its review round {round} failed.

board.lane.unrecorded.defaultMessage: {card} {title} · not recorded: the lane ended before Combwork kept where its cards were
board.lane.unrecorded.description: A lane segment's label (Progress panel), in a lane that ended before Combwork recorded its cards' columns. {card} is the card’s name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none, {title} its title (the user's own words).

board.lane.unrecordedUntitled.defaultMessage: {card} · not recorded: the lane ended before Combwork kept where its cards were
board.lane.unrecordedUntitled.description: A lane segment's label (Progress panel), in a lane that ended before Combwork recorded its cards' columns. {card} is the card’s name: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none.

board.lane.workChecks.defaultMessage: Checks on it: {passed, number} passed, {failed, number} failed
board.lane.workChecks.description: A line in a lane segment's hover (Progress panel): how many of the checks on the card's revision passed and failed (each check's latest run that counted).

board.lane.workMerged.description: A line in a lane segment's hover (Progress panel), for a Done card: the commit that merged it (a short commit id).

board.lane.workNoCode.description: A line in a lane segment's hover (Progress panel): the card is a no-code card (its work isn't code), so it has no commits to show. Glossary: no-code card.

board.lane.workRefused.defaultMessage: Refused {times, number} times in a row.
board.lane.workRefused.description: A line in a lane segment's hover (Progress panel), for its red notch, after the refusal's reason and next step (each a line of its own): the card's latest request was refused by its workflow rules this many times in a row ({times}, more than one). Glossary: refused, rule.

board.lane.workRevision.description: A line in a lane segment's hover (Progress panel): the card's revision (a short commit id, a3f2c1d), the one under review when the card is in Review.

board.lane.workStalePass.defaultMessage: {now, select, none {Pass was for {approved}: it no longer holds} other {Pass was for {approved}; now at {current}}}
board.lane.workStalePass.description: A line in a lane segment's hover (Progress panel), with its stale mark: the card's pass was for one revision ({approved}, a short commit id) and the card is at another now ({current}); none: the revision now isn't known. Keep the select keys.

board.lane.workVerdict.defaultMessage: {pass, select, yes {Last verdict: passed} other {Last verdict: failed}}{revision, select, none {} other { on {revision}}}{current, select, no {, which no longer counts} other {}}
board.lane.workVerdict.description: A line in a lane segment's hover (Progress panel): the card's last review verdict, passed or failed, on which revision (a short commit id; none for a card without one: keep that branch empty), and whether it no longer counts (a newer change or decision since). Keep the select keys as they are.

board.laneStart.addCard.description: The first entry of the Start Lane dialog's card picker: choosing a card adds it at the end of the lane's list. Todo is a board column.

board.laneStart.agentState.description: An agent in the Start Lane dialog's choices, with what it is doing ({status}: "Working…", "Not running").

board.laneStart.applyNow.description: A checkbox of the Start Lane dialog (HI-1995), off by default, shown when the builder's running lane has a card being worked: the new list applies at once instead of after that card is Done.

board.laneStart.applyNowHint.defaultMessage: {builder}'s lane is working on {card}: this list applies once {card} is Done. Apply now puts {card} back in Todo first (its work stays on its branch), so the new order applies at once, and tells {builder}.
board.laneStart.applyNowHint.description: Under the Apply now checkbox of the Start Lane dialog (HI-1995): {builder} (an agent's name) has a running lane whose card {card} (its key) is in progress. Todo is a board column.

board.laneStart.applyNowNot.defaultMessage: {builder}'s lane is working on {card}, which is in {column, select, review {Review} other {Approved}}: this list applies once it is Done. It can't be put back now without losing its {column, select, review {review} other {approval and merge}}.
board.laneStart.applyNowNot.description: In the Start Lane dialog (HI-1995), with Apply now unavailable: the builder's ({builder}) lane card {card} is already in the Review or Approved column (select; translate each).

board.laneStart.builder.description: A field label in the Start Lane dialog: the agent that builds the cards. Glossary: builder.

board.laneStart.busyNow.defaultMessage: {agents} {n, plural, one {is busy} other {are busy}} now: Wait and Start waits until {n, plural, one {it is} other {they are}} idle, then starts the lane.
board.laneStart.busyNow.description: In the Start Lane dialog: the chosen builder or reviewer ({agents}: their names, joined) can't start a new conversation now; the Wait and Start button waits for them.

board.laneStart.cancel.description: Button of the Start Lane dialog: closes it without starting anything (and stops waiting).

board.laneStart.cards.description: A field label in the Start Lane dialog: the cards the lane works through, in the order they are worked.

board.laneStart.deferred.description: A toast's title (HI-2034): the lane was started, but its agent {agent} was busy (in a turn, or reading a message Combwork had just given it), so it isn't in its new conversation yet.

board.laneStart.deferredText.defaultMessage: Combwork starts {agent} in a new conversation with the lane’s brief as soon as its turn is over. The lane’s row says so meanwhile, and its cards wait for it.
board.laneStart.deferredText.description: The text of the toast when a lane's agent ({agent}) was busy as the lane started (HI-2034): Combwork starts it in a new conversation once it is free; the lane's row in the Progress panel says it waits. Glossary: lane, conversation.

board.laneStart.down.description: Tooltip of a button in the Start Lane dialog: moves the card ({card}, its key) one place later in the lane.

board.laneStart.intro.defaultMessage: The builder works through the cards in this order, one at a time, and the reviewer reviews each. Both start in a new conversation with a brief: the cards, where the builder works, what the project’s rules ask, and your note.
board.laneStart.intro.description: At the top of the Start Lane dialog. Glossary: lane, rule.

board.laneStart.name.description: A field label in the Start Lane dialog: a short name for the lane, shown in the Progress panel.

board.laneStart.noAgents.defaultMessage: The project has no agents. Add one first.
board.laneStart.noAgents.description: In the Start Lane dialog: the chosen project has no agents to build the cards.

board.laneStart.noBuilders.defaultMessage: None of the project’s agents builds. Set Role in the workflow to Builder or Either in an agent’s settings.
board.laneStart.noBuilders.description: In the Start Lane dialog: every agent of the project is a reviewer, so none can build the cards. Role in the workflow, Builder and Either are the Agent Settings field and its choices: use their translated names. Glossary: builder, either.

board.laneStart.noCards.defaultMessage: No cards yet: add them from the project’s Todo below.
board.laneStart.noCards.description: In the Start Lane dialog's list of cards, while none is chosen. Todo is a board column.

board.laneStart.noReviewer.description: A choice of the Start Lane dialog’s reviewer: the lane has none (the project’s rules may need one).

board.laneStart.notRunning.description: An agent's state in the Start Lane dialog's choices: its session isn't running (it starts with the brief).

board.laneStart.notStarted.description: A toast's title: the lane was recorded, but one of its agents ({agent}) couldn't be started. The reason follows.

board.laneStart.notStartedText.defaultMessage: {why} The lane is recorded: start {agent} yourself, or end the lane from its row in the Progress panel.
board.laneStart.notStartedText.description: The text of the toast when a lane's agent ({agent}) didn't start: why ({why}, a sentence), and what the user can do.

board.laneStart.note.description: A field label in the Start Lane dialog: anything the user wants both agents to know, added to their brief.

board.laneStart.pool.description: A choice of the Start Lane dialog’s reviewer (#1443): the lane is reviewed by the project’s pool of reviewer agents ({agents}: their names, joined), each card going to the next free one. Glossary: reviewer pool.

board.laneStart.poolNobody.description: In the Start Lane dialog’s reviewer choice “The reviewer pool (…)”, in place of the names: no agent of the project reviews yet.

board.laneStart.project.description: A field label in the Start Lane dialog: the project whose cards the lane works through.

board.laneStart.remove.description: Tooltip of a button in the Start Lane dialog: removes the card ({card}, its key) from the lane's list (the card stays on the board).

board.laneStart.reviewer.description: A field label in the Start Lane dialog: the agent that reviews each card. Glossary: reviewer.

board.laneStart.show.description: A button on the toast after a lane started: shows its builder.

board.laneStart.start.description: Button of the Start Lane dialog: records the lane and starts both agents.

board.laneStart.started.description: A toast's title after a lane started from the window: its builder / reviewer ({pair}). Glossary: lane.

board.laneStart.startedText.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}}. Each agent starts in a new conversation with its brief.
board.laneStart.startedText.description: The text of the toast after a lane started: how many cards ({n}), and that both agents started fresh with their brief.

board.laneStart.starting.description: The Start Lane button while the lane is being started.

board.laneStart.target.description: HI-2556: a field label in the Start Lane dialog: the branch the lane’s cards are made from and merge into (Darren’s name for it).

board.laneStart.targetDefault.description: HI-2556: the first choice of the Start Lane dialog’s Merges into: the project’s Work merges into, {branch} its name.

board.laneStart.title.description: Title of the Start Lane dialog: a builder and a reviewer agent work through cards in turn (a lane, a card loop), started from the window. Glossary: lane.

board.laneStart.up.description: Tooltip of a button in the Start Lane dialog: moves the card ({card}, its key) one place earlier in the lane.

board.laneStart.waitAndStart.description: Button of the Start Lane dialog while the builder or reviewer is busy: waits until they are idle, then starts the lane.

board.laneStart.waiting.defaultMessage: Waiting for these agents to be idle: {agents}…
board.laneStart.waiting.description: In the Start Lane dialog, after Wait and Start: it waits for the busy agents ({agents}: their names, joined) before starting the lane. Cancel stops waiting. The names follow a colon (glossary §1 rule 4).

board.lanes.abandon.description: A lane's context menu item in the Progress panel: gives the lane up unmerged, after asking. Glossary: lane.

board.lanes.abandonConfirm.description: The confirm button of the question before abandoning a lane (Progress panel).

board.lanes.abandonMessage.defaultMessage: The lane stops here, unmerged: its cards stay where they are, and its agents are told no more. Start a new lane to carry on.
board.lanes.abandonMessage.description: The question before abandoning a lane (Progress panel): what abandoning does. Glossary: lane.

board.lanes.abandonTitle.description: Title of the question before abandoning a lane from the Progress panel: the lane's builder / reviewer and its name ({lane}). Glossary: lane.

board.lanes.alreadyEnd.defaultMessage: {where, select, first {{lane} is already the first running lane} other {{lane} is already the last running lane}}
board.lanes.alreadyEnd.description: Said to screen readers when a lane (its builder / reviewer: {lane}) is moved with Alt+Up or Alt+Down but is already first or last among the running lanes.

board.lanes.bar.defaultMessage: {pair}: {finished} of {total, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}} finished
board.lanes.bar.description: Accessible name of a lane's bar (Progress panel): the builder / reviewer ({pair}), and how many of its cards are finished (passed or done).

board.lanes.barUnrecorded.defaultMessage: {pair}: {total, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}}, not recorded
board.lanes.barUnrecorded.description: Accessible name of a lane's bar (Progress panel) when the lane ended before Combwork recorded where its cards were: the builder / reviewer ({pair}) and how many cards.

board.lanes.copyMerge.description: Tooltip of a Done card's merge commit in a lane's cards (Progress panel → Lanes): copies its whole id ({commit}).

board.lanes.edge.description: Accessible name of the handle on the top edge of the Progress panel's lanes: drag it for more or fewer lanes.

board.lanes.edgeTip.defaultMessage: Drag to show more or fewer lanes; double-click for {lanes}
board.lanes.edgeTip.description: Tooltip of the handle on the top edge of the Progress panel's lanes. {lanes} is the default number of lanes shown.

board.lanes.edgeValue.defaultMessage: {shown} of {count, plural, one {# lane} other {# lanes}} shown
board.lanes.edgeValue.description: The value of the handle on the top edge of the Progress panel's lanes, for screen readers: {shown} of the {count} lanes show.

board.lanes.end.description: A lane's context menu item in the Progress panel: ends the lane (its agents' card loop is over; the cards stay as they are). Glossary: lane.

board.lanes.endFailed.description: A toast's title: ending a lane from the Progress panel failed ({lane}: its builder / reviewer and name). The reason follows.

board.lanes.expand.defaultMessage: {open, select, yes {Hide the cards of {lane}} other {Show the cards of {lane}}}
board.lanes.expand.description: Tooltip of the chevron before a lane's name in the Progress panel's Lanes tab: shows or hides its cards in order ({lane}: its builder / reviewer). Keep the select keys.

board.lanes.fold.description: Tooltip of the Progress panel's Lanes bar: folds the lanes down to the bar.

board.lanes.freshBlocked.defaultMessage: {agent}’s new conversation didn’t start ({why, select, timeout {it wasn’t free in time} uncertain {Combwork closed as it started} other {{reason}}}): retry it, or end the lane
board.lanes.freshBlocked.description: Why a lane waits, in its header in the Progress panel (HI-2034): its agent {agent} (an agent's name) is owed a new conversation for the lane, and Combwork stopped trying. why (select): it wasn't free within the wait (Settings → Advanced); Combwork closed while starting it, so it may not have started; or (other) its start failed, {reason} saying why (a sentence, may be in English). The row's Retry New Conversation button tries again. Translate each.

board.lanes.latestRun.defaultMessage: {card}'s latest run: {run}, {state, select, running {running} passed {passed} failed {failed} other {stopped}}
board.lanes.latestRun.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the dot after a lane's current card (Progress panel): that card's latest run ({run}: its title) and how it is going or went. Keep the select keys.

board.lanes.legendButton.description: A button in the Progress panel's Lanes tab: its hover and focus show what a lane's colours and patterns mean (the board's stages, by category).

board.lanes.legendHold.description: A line of the lanes' legend (Progress panel): the red hatching is a card On Hold ({category}: that category's name) or blocked.

board.lanes.legendLine.description: A line of the lanes' legend for screen readers (Progress panel): a category ({category}: its name, such as Approved) and the stages in it ({stages}: their names, a list, such as "Approved and Merging"). Glossary: stage, category.

board.lanes.legendTitle.defaultMessage: Each colour is a category, with the stages in it
board.lanes.legendTitle.description: The heading of the lanes' legend (Progress panel, on the Lanes bar's hover): what each colour and pattern of a lane's card segments means, by the board's categories and the stages in them. Glossary: stage, category.

board.lanes.mergeCopied.description: A notification after copying a Done card's merge commit from a lane's cards (Progress panel → Lanes).

board.lanes.moveDown.description: A lane's context menu item in the Progress panel: moves it down among the running lanes.

board.lanes.moveUp.description: A lane's context menu item in the Progress panel: moves it up among the running lanes.

board.lanes.moved.defaultMessage: {lane} moved: {at} of {n, plural, one {# running lane} other {# running lanes}}
board.lanes.moved.description: Said to screen readers after a lane is moved in the Progress panel: the lane (its builder / reviewer, and its name in brackets), and its place now ({at}) among the {n} running lanes.

board.lanes.none.defaultMessage: No lanes. When a builder and a reviewer work through cards in turn (a card loop), their lane shows here with each card.
board.lanes.none.description: The Progress panel's Lanes tab when there are no lanes. Glossary: lane.

board.lanes.oldRules.description: A lane's mark in its header (Progress panel), lower case: the project's workflow options changed while the lane ran, and it keeps the ones it started with until it ends; its tooltip says so. Glossary: workflow options.

board.lanes.oldRulesTip.defaultMessage: Old rules: this lane started under the workflow options from before they changed, and keeps them until it ends. New lanes and cards use the new options.{enforced, select, no { Workflow rules aren’t enforced now (Settings → Advanced).} other {}}
board.lanes.oldRulesTip.description: Tooltip and accessible name of a lane's "old rules" mark (Progress panel): the project's workflow options changed while the lane ran; it keeps the ones it started with until it ends. enforced no: the switch "Workflow rules are enforced" (Settings → Advanced) is off. Keep the select keys. Glossary: lane, workflow options.

board.lanes.poolLastVerdict.description: A pool lane's hover in the Progress panel (#1446): who gave the current card's last verdict ({name}, an agent's name) and whether it passed or failed. Keep the select keys. Glossary: verdict, pass / fail.

board.lanes.poolPair.description: A lane's agents in its header in the Progress panel when its cards are reviewed by the project's reviewer pool (#1443): its builder's name ({builder}), then the pool, short (the header is narrow). Glossary: pool (of reviewers).

board.lanes.poolReviewing.defaultMessage: {reviewing, select, none {Reviewed by the pool: nobody on the card yet} other {Reviewed by the pool: {name} now}}
board.lanes.poolReviewing.description: A lane's hover in the Progress panel when its cards are reviewed by the project's reviewer pool (#1446): who reviews its current card now ({name}, an agent's name), or nobody yet (it waits for a free reviewer). Keep the select keys.

board.lanes.projectLink.defaultMessage: {project}: open its workflow in Version Control
board.lanes.projectLink.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the project's name in a lane's header (Progress panel): opens that project's Version Control tab (a tab's name) at its Workflow section. {project} is the project's name.

board.lanes.queue.description: Accessible name of a lane's cards in order, opened under it in the Progress panel's Lanes tab ({lane}: its builder / reviewer).

board.lanes.queueState.defaultMessage: {state, select, done {Done} doing {Active} review {In review} todo {To do} waiting {Waiting for you} gone {Gone} other {Not recorded}}
board.lanes.queueState.description: A card's state in a lane's cards, opened in the Progress panel's Lanes tab (its icon's name): done, being worked on, in review, not started, waiting for the user (blocked, on hold or at its round limit), gone from the board, or not recorded by the lane. Keep the select keys.

board.lanes.queuedAdded.description: Part of a lane's queued list change (Progress panel → Lanes, HI-2151): the cards {cards} (their keys, such as HI-12, joined: "HI-12 and HI-13"; {n} of them) are added to the lane's list. Combwork joins the parts with commas.

board.lanes.queuedChange.defaultMessage: {after, select, yes {Next, once {card} is Done: {changes}} other {Next: {changes}}}
board.lanes.queuedChange.description: A line under a lane's cards in the Progress panel's Lanes tab (HI-2151): a change to the lane's list of cards made while a card was in flight, which Combwork applies once that card ({card}, its key such as HI-12) is Done (merged); other: the card isn't known. {changes}: what changes, such as "HI-13 added, HI-9 moves to HB6’s lane". Keep the select keys. Glossary: Done, lane.

board.lanes.queuedMoves.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {{cards} moves to {builder}’s lane} other {{cards} move to {builder}’s lane}}
board.lanes.queuedMoves.description: Part of a lane's queued list change (Progress panel → Lanes, HI-2151): the cards {cards} (their keys, joined; {n} of them) leave this lane's list for another lane's, whose builder is {builder} (an agent's name, such as HB6). Combwork joins the parts with commas.

board.lanes.queuedOrder.description: Part of a lane's queued list change (Progress panel → Lanes, HI-2151), lower case: its cards change order, and {cards} is the whole new list in order (keys, such as HI-12, joined with commas). Combwork joins the parts with commas.

board.lanes.queuedRemoved.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {{cards} taken off} other {{cards} taken off}}
board.lanes.queuedRemoved.description: Part of a lane's queued list change (Progress panel → Lanes, HI-2151): the cards {cards} (their keys, joined; {n} of them) are taken off the lane's list. Combwork joins the parts with commas.

board.lanes.retryFresh.description: A button in a lane's header (Progress panel) and an item of its menu (HI-2034): one of the lane's agents was owed a new conversation, and Combwork stopped trying to start it (it wasn't free in time, Combwork closed while starting it, or its start failed); this tries again, once the agent is free. Glossary: lane, conversation.

board.lanes.retryFreshFailed.description: A toast's title (HI-2034): Retry New Conversation on a lane's row failed ({lane}: its builder / reviewer). The reason follows.

board.lanes.retryFreshShort.description: A lane's header in the Progress panel (HI-2034), after a refresh icon: a button that tries again to start the lane's agent {agent} (an agent's name) in a new conversation, which Combwork stopped trying. Short: the panel is narrow; its tooltip says why in full.

board.lanes.round.description: A card's round in a lane's cards (Progress panel → Lanes), short: r1 for its first, r3 after two failed reviews.

board.lanes.show.description: Tooltip of the Progress panel's Lanes bar when the lanes are folded away.

board.lanes.slotLine.description: A lane's slot in its hover (Progress panel, #1446): the branch its current card is built on there follows ({line}, such as cw/HI/HI-12-fix-login: keep it as it is).

board.lanes.slotLink.description: Tooltip and accessible name of a lane's slot in its header (Progress panel, #1446): opens the project's Version Control tab at Branches & remotes, where its slots are listed. {slot} is the slot's name (slot-b): keep it as it is. Branches & remotes is a section of the tab: use its name as shown there.

board.lanes.slotTip.defaultMessage: {state, select, preparing {being prepared} other {ready}} · {carried, select, yes {its builder’s own since {since}} other {lent to the lane since {since}}}
board.lanes.slotTip.description: A lane's slot in its hover (Progress panel, #1446), after the slot's name (slot-b): whether it is ready or being prepared (its setup or a dependency install), then since when it was lent to the lane, or, for a builder's own worktree kept from before 1.0 (carried), since when it has had it. {since} is a date and time. Keep the select keys.

board.lanes.soFar.description: How long a lane's card has been worked on so far, in its cards (Progress panel → Lanes). {time}: 4 min, 1 h 5 min.

board.lanes.stalled.description: A lane's mark in its header (Progress panel), lower case: one of its cards is stalled (nobody is working on it); its tooltip says why.

board.lanes.start.description: A button in the Progress panel's Lanes tab and an item of a lane's menu: opens Start Lane (a builder and a reviewer agent work through cards in turn). Glossary: lane.

board.lanes.state.description: A lane's state in its header in the Progress panel, lower case (a lane: a builder and its reviewer working through cards in turn): paused, merged (it ended: its cards were merged) or abandoned.

board.lanes.target.description: HI-2556: a lane’s mark in its header (Progress panel), lower case: its cards merge into {branch} (a branch name), not the project’s Work merges into.

board.lanes.targetTip.defaultMessage: This lane’s cards are made from {branch} and merge into it, not the project’s Work merges into, until the lane ends.
board.lanes.targetTip.description: HI-2556: tooltip and accessible name of a lane header’s Merges into mark (Progress panel). {branch} is a branch name.

board.lanes.teamPause.description: Why a lane waits, in its header in the Progress panel, lower case (HI-2081): the user (or the Combwork Assistant) paused the whole team before an update, so Combwork starts none of the lane's cards and wakes none of its agents until the team resumes. 'The team' is every agent of the workspace.

board.lanes.title.description: The Progress panel's section of lanes (a builder and its reviewer working through cards in turn): its bar's label and accessible name.

board.lanes.took.description: How long a lane's Done card took, from its start to its merge, in its cards (Progress panel → Lanes). {time}: 4 min, 1 h 5 min.

board.lanes.usualOrder.description: A lane's context menu item in the Progress panel: puts the lanes back in their usual order, undoing the user's own.

board.lanes.usualOrderDetail.defaultMessage: Running lanes newest first, paused ones after them
board.lanes.usualOrderDetail.description: Under Usual Order in a lane's context menu (Progress panel): what the usual order is.

board.lanes.usualOrderSaid.defaultMessage: Lanes back in the usual order
board.lanes.usualOrderSaid.description: Said to screen readers after the Progress panel's lanes go back to their usual order (Usual Order, in a lane's menu).

board.lanes.waitedAtLeast.description: How long a lane has waited, in its header (Progress panel), when Combwork didn't see its wait begin (it was already waiting when Combwork started): at least {time} (4 min, 1 h 5 min).

board.lanes.waitedAtLeastTip.defaultMessage: It was already waiting when Combwork first saw it: it has waited at least this long.
board.lanes.waitedAtLeastTip.description: Tooltip of a lane's wait time with a + in its header (Progress panel): Combwork didn't see the wait begin.

board.lanes.waitingForYou.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# waiting for you} other {# waiting for you}}
board.lanes.waitingForYou.description: In the Progress panel's Lanes bar, after how many lanes there are: how many of them wait for the user's answer (an approval, a decision, a round limit). Glossary: lane.

board.lanes.waits.defaultMessage: {reason, select, blocked {{card} is blocked} hold {{card} is On Hold} you {waiting for you ({ask, select, approve {approval} decide {a decision} test {a test} signIn {a sign-in} other {an answer}}): {card}} roundLimit {waiting for you: {card} reached its round limit} notMerged {waiting: {card} not merged} merging {waiting: {card} merging} stale {stale: {card} must be submitted again} reviewer {waiting for a reviewer on {card}} lineUpdate {waiting: bringing the builder’s branch up to date before {card}} hooks {paused: {agent}'s hooks aren't arriving} checkCopy {waiting for a check copy for {card}} slot {waiting for a slot} other {list changes after {card}}}
board.lanes.waits.description: Why a lane (a builder and its reviewer working through cards) waits, in its header in the Progress panel, lower case. {card} is a card's name (its key, such as HI-12). reason: blocked or On Hold (a board column); waiting for the user (ask: for their approval, a decision, a test, a sign-in or another answer); at its round limit (the user decides how to go on); a card passed but not merged yet (or merging now), so the next can't start (one card at a time); its pass is stale (the builder must submit again); nobody reviews it; Combwork brings the builder's branch up to date before that card (after a squash merge, #1271); hooks: the agent {agent} (a name) has stopped sending Combwork its hooks (the calls that tell Combwork what it is doing), so the lane is paused; checkCopy: its review or check waits for a check copy (a folder Combwork keeps at one revision for a review or an isolated check) to be free; slot: every slot (a working folder Combwork lends to a card or a lane) is in use, so the lane can't start until one is free; changes to the lane's list of cards apply once that card is done (other). Keep the select keys. Glossary: lane, round limit, stale.

board.lanes.waitsDependency.defaultMessage: {card} waits to start: it waits for {dependency} to merge
board.lanes.waitsDependency.description: Why a lane waits, in its header in the Progress panel (HI-2129): its card {card} (its key, such as HI-12) is due to start, but it depends on the cards {dependency} (their keys, such as HI-11, or HI-10, HI-11 and HI-12 as a list in the language: HI-2618), which aren't merged (Done) yet, and Combwork starts a card only once the cards it depends on are. Combwork starts it once the last of them is merged, or (with the workflow rules off) tells its builder. The lane isn't paused.

board.lanes.waitsFresh.defaultMessage: waiting: {agent} starts in a new conversation once it is free
board.lanes.waitsFresh.description: Why a lane waits, in its header in the Progress panel, lower case (HI-2034): its agent {agent} (an agent's name) was busy as the lane started (in a turn, or reading a message), so Combwork starts it in a new conversation with the lane's brief once it is free. The lane isn't paused.

board.lanes.waitsLink.description: Tooltip of why a lane waits, in its header (Progress panel, #1446), when a click shows what it waits for: its slot or the slots in use (Branches & remotes), or the runs it waits on (the Runs tab). It follows the reason, on a line of its own ("waiting for a slot").

board.lanes.waitsPreparing.description: Why a lane waits, in its header in the Progress panel, lower case: Combwork is preparing its slot (a working folder it lends to the lane: its setup command or a dependency install before the next card). {slot} is the slot's name, such as slot-b: keep it as it is. The lane isn't paused.

board.lanes.waitsSlotHeld.defaultMessage: waiting for {slot}: {held, select, session {{agent}’s session is still in it} broker {a process still has a file or folder in it open: Windows Sandbox’s broker ({broker}) is working in it{idle, select, yes {, with no Sandbox running} no {, with a Sandbox running} other {}}} other {a process still has a file or folder in it open}}
board.lanes.waitsSlotHeld.description: Why a lane waits, in its header in the Progress panel, lower case (HI-2466): the lane waits for a slot (a working folder Combwork lends to a lane), and the only free one, {slot} (its name, such as slot-b: keep it as it is), can't be lent yet because something still uses it. held (select): session, the agent {agent} (an agent's name) still has a session running in it; broker (HI-2467), a process still has a file or folder in it open, and Windows Sandbox's broker ({broker}: its process name, WindowsSandboxServer: keep it as it is) is seen using the slot as its working folder; other, a process still has a file or folder in it open (often a program the last agent there started, still closing). idle (select, only with broker): yes, no Windows Sandbox is running; no, one is; other, not known (nothing said). Combwork lends the slot by itself once it is free. Translate each.

board.lanes.waitsStart.defaultMessage: {card} waits to start: {why, select, watching {{agent} is waiting on other work} queued {a line of Combwork’s is on its way to {agent}} failed {{agent}’s last start failed} refused {its start was refused for now, and Combwork tries again} other {{agent} is in a turn}}
board.lanes.waitsStart.description: Why a lane waits, in its header in the Progress panel (HI-2029): its card {card} (its key, such as HI-12) is due to start but isn't started yet. why (select): its builder {agent} (an agent's name) is waiting on other work (a card watch); a line Combwork types (a message or a wake) is about to reach it; its last start failed; Combwork's start was refused for now and is tried again; or (other) it is in a turn (working, starting, waiting for the user). Translate each. The lane isn't paused.

board.lanes.waitsStartHeld.defaultMessage: {card} waits to start: its start was refused for now, {slot} still in use ({held, select, session {{agent}’s session is still in it} left {{agent}’s last run left {program}{more, plural, =0 {} other { and # more}} running in it} lastRun {{agent}’s last run there isn’t known to have ended} broker {a process still has a file or folder in it open: Windows Sandbox’s broker ({broker}) is working in it{idle, select, yes {, with no Sandbox running} no {, with a Sandbox running} other {}}} other {a process still has a file or folder in it open}}), and Combwork tries again
board.lanes.waitsStartHeld.description: Why a lane waits, in its header in the Progress panel (HI-2468): its card {card} (its key, such as HI-12) is due to start, but Combwork's start of it was refused because its slot {slot} (a working folder Combwork lends to a lane, such as slot-a: keep it as it is) is still in use. held (select): session, the agent {agent} (an agent's name) still has a session running in it; left, the agent {agent}'s last run left programs running in it ({program}: the first one's process name, such as node: keep it as it is; {more}: how many more, a number); lastRun, that last run of {agent}'s there isn't known to have ended; broker, a process still has a file or folder in it open, and Windows Sandbox's broker ({broker}: its process name, WindowsSandboxServer: keep it as it is) is seen using the slot as its working folder; other, a process still has a file or folder in it open (often a program the last agent there started, still closing). idle (select, only with broker): yes, no Windows Sandbox is running; no, one is; other, not known (nothing said). Combwork tries the start again. Translate each. The lane isn't paused.

board.leftOut.detail.defaultMessage: {hasPaths, select, yes {Its paths: {paths}.} other {It has no paths yet.}} A file changed meanwhile may be another card's work or your own: include only what belongs to {card}.
board.leftOut.detail.description: Under the files listed in the question before submitting a card of a project without version control: its paths now ({paths}, a list of file paths; {hasPaths} is yes or no: keep both as they are), and a warning that a changed file may belong to another card or the user's own edit. {card} is the card's name.

board.leftOut.include.description: A button of the question before submitting a card of a project without version control: adds the {n} changed files listed to its paths, and submits it with them. Title case, as the dialog's other buttons.

board.leftOut.leave.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {Leave It Out} other {Leave Them Out}}
board.leftOut.leave.description: A button of the question before submitting a card of a project without version control: submits it with its paths as they are, without the {n} changed files listed. Title case, as the dialog's other buttons.

board.leftOut.message.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {This file changed since {card} started, but isn't in its paths. Without version control, its work is only the files its paths list, so its review won't see this one:} other {These # files changed since {card} started, but aren't in its paths. Without version control, its work is only the files its paths list, so its review won't see them:}}
board.leftOut.message.description: The question before a card of a project without version control is submitted: {n} files changed since the card started that its paths (the files its work is made of) don't list; they are listed below. {card} is the card's name.

board.leftOut.title.description: Title of the question before a card of a project without version control is submitted (moved to Review): files changed that its paths (the files its work is made of) don't list. {card} is the card's name (its key, such as AM-12, or #12).

board.links.archivedTitle.description: The hover of a card number (#12) in a terminal, for an archived card: its name (its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none), title (the user's own words), the column it was archived from ({column}), and how to open it.

board.links.title.description: The hover of a card number (#12) in a terminal: its name (its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none), title (the user's own words), its board column ({column}), and how to open it.

board.menu.clearWaiting.description: Menu item on a card in Active that waits on purpose (right-click, HI-2618): clears that mark, so Combwork reports it as stalled again if nobody gets on with it.

board.menu.delete.description: Menu item on a card (right-click): deletes it after asking.

board.menu.markWaiting.description: Menu item on a card in Active (right-click, HI-2618): opens the card's dialog to say why it waits on purpose (held for a quiet window, say), so Combwork doesn't report it as stalled meanwhile.

board.menu.moveTo.description: A heading in a card's right-click menu, above the board columns it can move to.

board.menu.nextRound.description: Menu item on a card that failed review and is still in Review: returns it to its reviewer for the next round. Review is the board column.

board.menu.open.description: Menu item on a card (right-click): opens the card's dialog.

board.menu.start.description: Menu item on a card (right-click): gives it to an agent to start (opens a dialog).

board.menu.startLane.description: Menu item on a Todo card (right-click): opens Start Lane with this card first in the lane's list (a lane: a builder and a reviewer working through cards in turn). Glossary: lane.

board.merge.fold.defaultMessage: Fold the merge to one line
board.merge.fold.description: Tooltip of the button folding a merge's card in the Progress panel to its first line.

board.merge.region.description: Accessible name of the top of the Progress panel: a card for each merge going on.

board.merge.time.description: How long a merge has held the merge slot ({sofar}: "3 min") and how long its hold has left ({left}: "57 min"), on its card in the Progress panel.

board.merge.timeOver.description: How long a merge has held the merge slot ({sofar}: "63 min"), on its card in the Progress panel, once its hold has run out.

board.merge.unfold.description: Tooltip of the button unfolding a merge's card in the Progress panel.

board.move.anyway.description: The button of the question before a move that skips rules: makes the move, recording it as an override (glossary: override).

board.move.askDetail.defaultMessage: Moving it anyway records an override on the card, with your reason.
board.move.askDetail.description: Under the rules a move would skip, in the question before it: making the move records it on the card as an exception to the rules (glossary: override), with the reason the user gives below.

board.move.askMessage.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {This skips a rule of its project:} other {This skips # rules of its project:}}
board.move.askMessage.description: The question before a move that skips workflow rules (glossary: rule): how many it skips ({n}), listed below by name. Moving anyway records an exception on the card (glossary: override), with the reason the user gives.

board.move.askTitle.description: Title of the question before a move that skips some of the card's workflow rules (glossary: rule). {card} is the card's name (its key, such as AM-12, or #12), {column} the board column it is moved to.

board.move.notMoved.defaultMessage: Your other changes are saved; the card stays in {column}.
board.move.notMoved.description: In the card dialog, after Save: the user changed the card's Column, but its move was cancelled or refused (a toast says why); everything else was saved. {column} is the board column it is in.

board.move.reason.description: The label of the field in the question before a move that skips rules: why the user makes the exception, kept with it on the card. Optional.

board.move.refused.description: A toast's title: a card's move was refused for something no exception to the rules can make true (nothing to submit, something Combwork couldn't read). {card} is the card's name, {column} a board column. The toast's text says why and what to do.

board.move.stopped.description: A toast's title: a drag went part of the way (the card's work started) and stopped in {column} (a board column), for something no exception to the rules can make true. {card} is the card's name. The toast's text says why and what to do.

board.newCard.button.description: The board toolbar's button that adds a card, and the title of the dialog it opens.

board.newCard.tip.description: Tooltip on the + buttons that add a card (the Todo column, the Board sidebar).

board.overview.blocked.description: A count on the Overview's board strip: cards that are blocked (can't go on). Follows the number.

board.overview.noCards.description: A project's Overview, where its cards are counted, when it has none.

board.overview.openTasks.description: Button on a project's Overview with no cards: opens its Tasks tab.

board.overview.stalled.description: Cards nobody is getting on with, counted: on the Overview's board strip (after the number) and as a heading in the Board sidebar.

board.overview.waitingForReview.description: Cards in the Review column, counted: on the Overview's board strip (after the number) and as a heading in the Board sidebar.

board.panel.allProjects.description: The Board sidebar's first row: shows every project's cards.

board.panel.info.defaultMessage: The workspace's cards, in .combwork/tasks. Agents and the Assistant read, change and move them through Combwork's tools (finished work goes to Review); only you archive or delete them.
board.panel.info.description: The (i) beside the Board sidebar's title. Keep .combwork/tasks as it is (a folder). Review is a board column.

board.panel.refresh.description: Tooltip on the Board sidebar's refresh button: reads the cards again.

board.panel.stalledInfo.defaultMessage: Cards in Active that nobody is working on: no agent has them, or their agent was removed or isn't running. Also cards in Active or Review that an agent in a card loop left without waiting on them.
board.panel.stalledInfo.description: The (i) beside the Board sidebar's Stalled heading. Active and Review are board columns.

board.panel.workspace.description: A row of the Board sidebar: shows the cards of no project (about the whole workspace).

board.progress.agentGone.description: Why a Progress panel run's agent can't be shown: the agent ({agent}) was removed from its project ({project}).

board.progress.allAgents.description: A choice of the Progress panel's agent filter: the runs of every agent of the chosen project.

board.progress.allProjects.description: A choice of the Progress panel's project filter: every project's runs.

board.progress.anAgent.description: Who ran a run in the Progress panel when Combwork doesn't have the agent's name (an older record).

board.progress.attention.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# run failed} other {# runs failed}}
board.progress.attention.description: A line in the Progress panel's Pulse tab: runs failed and no later run of the same thing passed since; a click shows them in the Runs tab.

board.progress.badgeLanes.description: What the badge on the Progress panel's Lanes tab means: how many lanes there are.

board.progress.badgeMerges.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# merge waiting} other {# merges waiting}}
board.progress.badgeMerges.description: What the badge on the Progress panel's Merges tab means: how many cards wait in the merge queues and agents wait for the merge slot.

board.progress.badgeRuns.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# failure nothing has passed since} other {# failures nothing has passed since}}
board.progress.badgeRuns.description: What the red badge on the Progress panel's Runs tab means: runs that failed with no later run of the same thing passing.

board.progress.blocksReview.description: Under a failed run in the Progress panel: the run was a check the card's rules require before it can go to Review, so the card can't until it passes. {card} is the card's name (its key, such as HI-12). Glossary: check, rule.

board.progress.cantShow.description: A notification's title: the agent ({agent}) that ran a Progress panel run can't be shown. Its message says why.

board.progress.combworkRun.defaultMessage: Combwork’s merge queue ran it, not an agent: there is no agent to show.
board.progress.combworkRun.description: Why a Progress panel run's agent can't be shown: Combwork's merge queue ran the run itself (a merge check on a card's merged result; glossary 2.5: merge queue).

board.progress.copied.description: A notification after copying a run's command or its details from the Progress panel.

board.progress.copiesRun.description: Who ran a run in the Progress panel when Combwork ran it itself to set up one of a project's review or check copies (folders at one revision where a reviewer reads a card's work, or an isolated check runs) and no agent's lease held the copy: its setup command or a dependency install. Also an entry of the panel's Agent filter.

board.progress.copyCommand.description: Button in a run's details (Progress panel): copies the command it ran.

board.progress.copyDetails.description: Button in a run's details (Progress panel): copies all of them as text, to paste elsewhere.

board.progress.copyFailed.defaultMessage: {what, select, command {Could not copy the command} other {Could not copy the details}}
board.progress.copyFailed.description: A notification: copying a run's command or its details from the Progress panel failed.

board.progress.copyRevision.description: Tooltip of a run's revision in the Progress panel (under its agent): copies the whole commit id. {revision} is its short form (a3f2c1d).

board.progress.detailsOf.description: Accessible name of a run's details in the Progress panel ({run}: the run's title).

board.progress.dismiss.defaultMessage: Dismiss (it stays in the Runs tab)
board.progress.dismiss.description: Tooltip of the button dismissing a failed or stale run in the Progress panel's Pulse tab. Runs is the panel's tab of every run (keep it as the panel names it).

board.progress.empty.defaultMessage: Nothing is running. When an agent runs tests or a build with progress reporting, it shows here with how far along it is and the time left.
board.progress.empty.description: The Progress panel when it has no runs.

board.progress.filterAgent.description: Accessible name of the Progress panel's agent filter, continuing the project filter's (Show the runs of): a list of the project's agents follows.

board.progress.filterProject.description: Accessible name of the Progress panel's project filter (a list of projects follows; the agent filter's name continues the sentence: …and of the agent).

board.progress.fold.description: Tooltip of the button folding the Progress panel to a strip at the window's edge. A shortcut may follow in brackets.

board.progress.hideDetails.description: Tooltip of the button closing a run's details in the Progress panel ({run}: the run's title).

board.progress.inCopy.description: Under a run's agent in the Progress panel, after its card and revision ("AM-12 · a3f2c1d · in copy-2"): the run ran in that review or check copy (a folder Combwork keeps at exactly the card's revision). {copy} is its name, such as copy-2: keep it as it is.

board.progress.mergeQueue.description: Who ran a run in the Progress panel when Combwork's merge queue ran it itself: a merge check or install on a card's merged result, not an agent (glossary 2.5: merge queue).

board.progress.miniWaiting.description: Tooltip of a run's small bar on the folded Progress strip: its agent, its title ({run}), and that it is waiting (for a test slot, say).

board.progress.moreOthers.defaultMessage: and {n, number} others: open the panel to see them
board.progress.moreOthers.description: The last line of the folded Progress strip's +N tooltip, after the runs it lists: how many more there are ({n}).

board.progress.moreRuns.description: Heading of the folded Progress strip's +N tooltip: the runs without a bar of their own ({n} of them) are listed under it.

board.progress.noAssistant.defaultMessage: The Assistant is not in this workspace.
board.progress.noAssistant.description: Why a Progress panel run's agent can't be shown: the run is the Combwork Assistant's, and this workspace has none.

board.progress.noMerges.defaultMessage: No merge is going on. While Combwork's merge queue merges a card, or an agent merges its branch, it shows here with its cards, its checks and what waits.
board.progress.noMerges.description: The Progress panel's Merges tab when nothing is merging: no merge queue shows, and no agent holds the merge slot. Glossary 2.5: merge queue.

board.progress.openCard.description: Tooltip of a run's card in the Progress panel (under its agent): opens the card. {card} is the card's reference (#1061).

board.progress.openLog.description: Button in a run's details (Progress panel): opens the log file its reporter named.

board.progress.openLogFailed.description: An error's title: opening a run's log file (Progress panel) failed.

board.progress.projectGone.defaultMessage: Its project is no longer in this workspace.
board.progress.projectGone.description: Why a Progress panel run's agent can't be shown: its project was removed from the workspace.

board.progress.railFiltered.description: The folded Progress strip's name when the panel is filtered: the project (or project · agent) shown ({name}), its runs in words ({summary}: 3 runs: 2 running, 1 failed), and how many runs there are in all ({all}).

board.progress.railFilteredNone.defaultMessage: {name} only: no runs; {all, number} in all
board.progress.railFilteredNone.description: The folded Progress strip's name when the panel is filtered and the project (or project · agent) shown ({name}) has no runs: how many runs there are in all ({all}).

board.progress.railLabel.description: The folded Progress panel's label, written down the strip at the window's edge. Keep it short.

board.progress.railShowing.description: Tooltip of the filter mark on the folded Progress strip: only one project's (or agent's) runs ({name}) show, {shown} of {all} runs.

board.progress.recentHover.description: Tooltip of a run in the Progress panel's Runs tab: its agent, its title ({run}) and its state in a few words ({state}: failed, stopped reporting…).

board.progress.recentHoverTook.description: Tooltip of a run in the Progress panel's Runs tab: its agent, its title ({run}), its state in a few words ({state}: failed, stopped reporting…) and how long it took ({took}: 4 min).

board.progress.region.description: Accessible name of the Progress panel (long runs agents report: tests, builds).

board.progress.revisionCopied.description: A notification after copying a run's revision (a commit id) from the Progress panel. {revision} is its short form (a3f2c1d).

board.progress.revisionCopyFailed.description: A notification: copying a run's revision (a commit id) from the Progress panel failed.

board.progress.script.description: Who ran a run in the Progress panel when a script (a program calling Combwork's Agent API) ran it, not an agent.

board.progress.scriptRun.defaultMessage: A script reported it, not an agent: there is no agent to show.
board.progress.scriptRun.description: Why a Progress panel run's agent can't be shown: a script reported the run.

board.progress.show.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the folded Progress strip at the window's edge: opens the panel. Its runs in words, or a shortcut, may follow in brackets.

board.progress.showAgent.description: Accessible name of the button showing the agent ({agent}) that ran a Progress panel run ({run}: the run's title).

board.progress.showAssistant.description: Accessible name of the button showing the Combwork Assistant, which ran a Progress panel run ({run}: the run's title).

board.progress.showDetails.description: Tooltip of the button opening a run's details in the Progress panel ({run}: the run's title).

board.progress.showLog.description: Button in a run's details (Progress panel): shows its log file in File Explorer.

board.progress.showLogFailed.description: An error's title: showing a run's log file in its folder (Progress panel) failed.

board.progress.showTheAgent.description: Button and tooltip on a Progress panel run: shows the agent that ran it.

board.progress.slotRun.description: Who ran a run in the Progress panel when Combwork ran it itself to set up one of a project's slots (a worktree Combwork lends to a card or a lane: its setup command, a dependency install or its archive command), not an agent. {slot} is the slot's name, such as slot-b: keep it as it is.

board.progress.stepOf.description: A run's step in the Progress panel, under its bar: step {step} of {total}.

board.progress.stepOfNamed.description: A run's step in the Progress panel, under its bar: step {step} of {total}, and the step's name ({name}, as its reporter named it).

board.progress.stopIsolated.defaultMessage: Stop this check and everything it started
board.progress.stopIsolated.description: Tooltip of the button stopping an isolated check (a check an agent runs in a copy of its own) in the Progress panel: Combwork ends its command and every process it started.

board.progress.tab.description: A tab of the Progress panel: Pulse (an overview of what is going on now), Merges, Runs (tests, builds and checks agents ran) or Lanes (card loops). Keep "Runs" as the panel says it everywhere. Keep the select keys.

board.progress.tabs.description: Accessible name of the Progress panel's tabs (Pulse, Merges, Runs, Lanes).

board.progress.title.description: The Progress panel's title, in its header (long runs agents report: tests, builds).

board.progress.waiting.description: A run's state on its bar (accessible value) and in a list of runs (build (waiting)), lower case: it waits (for a test slot, say).

board.queue.empty.description: A merge queue's card in the Progress panel when no card is waiting or being merged.

board.queue.filesMore.description: The last item of a list of the files a merge conflict named, when there are more than shown: how many more ({n}). The list joins it to the first few as your language joins a list (HI-1585: no "and" written around a list).

board.queue.inVersionControl.description: A link on a merge queue's card in the Progress panel: shows the project's Version Control tab at its Merge queue section, with its history.

board.queue.merged.description: A merge queue's card in the Progress panel, for a few seconds after a card merged: its key ({card}, such as HI-61) and the target's new commit ({result}: a short commit id).

board.queue.moreReturned.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# more returned card: it shows here once you have seen these.} other {# more returned cards: they show here as you see these.}}
board.queue.moreReturned.description: Under the returned cards on a merge queue's card in the Progress panel, when more are waiting to be shown ({n}): each shows once those above have been seen. Glossary 2.4: returned.

board.queue.openCard.description: A button on a merge queue's card in the Progress panel: opens the card it names (a return, a pause that needs the user).

board.queue.openNamed.description: Tooltip of a queued card's key on a merge queue's card in the Progress panel: opens the card ({card}: its key).

board.queue.pause.description: A button on a merge queue's card in the Progress panel: stops it before its next card (saved). Glossary 2.5: Pause queue.

board.queue.pause.approval.defaultMessage: {card} is ready to merge into {target}, which is checked out: it waits for your OK in For you.
board.queue.pause.approval.description: Why a merge queue is paused, on its card in the Progress panel: a card ({card}: its key) waits for the user's approval to update the checked-out target ({target}: a branch). For you is the list of what waits on the user (glossary 2.3).

board.queue.pause.byAssistant.defaultMessage: Paused by the Assistant. The queue merges nothing until it is resumed.
board.queue.pause.byAssistant.description: Why a merge queue is paused, on its card in the Progress panel: the Combwork Assistant paused it (Pause queue).

board.queue.pause.byYou.defaultMessage: Paused by you. The queue merges nothing until you resume it.
board.queue.pause.byYou.description: Why a merge queue is paused, on its card in the Progress panel: the user paused it (Pause queue).

board.queue.pause.checkedOut.defaultMessage: {target} is checked out in a folder. Combwork merges into it there now: resume to carry on.
board.queue.pause.checkedOut.description: Why a merge queue is paused, on its card in the Progress panel: an older pause, from before Combwork could merge into a checked-out branch ({target}).

board.queue.pause.folderBusy.defaultMessage: The folder {target} is checked out in was busy (an operation such as a merge or rebase was going on there).
board.queue.pause.folderBusy.description: Why a merge queue is paused, on its card in the Progress panel: the folder where the target ({target}: a branch) is checked out was in the middle of a git operation.

board.queue.pause.hookTimedOut.defaultMessage: A hook of the merge commit was still running when signing's time ran out.
board.queue.pause.hookTimedOut.description: Why a merge queue is paused, on its card in the Progress panel: a git hook kept running past the time limit.

board.queue.pause.identity.defaultMessage: The repository has no commit identity, so Combwork can't make its merge commit. Set one in Version Control → Branches & remotes, then resume.
board.queue.pause.identity.description: Why a merge queue is paused, on its card in the Progress panel: git has no user name and email for the repository. Version Control → Branches & remotes is a place in Combwork.

board.queue.pause.mergeChoice.defaultMessage: {card} is the first card to merge since the upgrade to Combwork 1.0: choose how Combwork merges this project (merge style and commit message) in For you, or in Version Control → Workflow.
board.queue.pause.mergeChoice.description: Why a merge queue is paused, on its card in the Progress panel (HI-1697): a project from before 1.0 reached the merge queue for the first time ({card}: its key), and nobody chose its merge style and commit message (workflow options' names, glossary 2.6), so it waits for the user. For you is the list of what waits on the user (glossary 2.3); Version Control → Workflow is a place in Combwork.

board.queue.pause.needsYou.defaultMessage: Needs you: Combwork stopped part way and changes nothing more on its own. Open the card for its state and the commands that finish or undo it.
board.queue.pause.needsYou.description: Why a merge queue is paused, on its card in the Progress panel: something Combwork couldn't settle by itself (a merge stopped part way, or what an earlier run left). Open the card: a button beside it.

board.queue.pause.other.description: Why a merge queue is paused, on its card in the Progress panel, for a reason this window has no words for ({reason}: Combwork's code for it).

board.queue.pause.pushFailed.defaultMessage: {card} is merged, but pushing {target} failed (git’s message follows). Fix it, then resume; or turn off “Push the target branch after merging” and resume to keep merging locally.
board.queue.pause.pushFailed.description: Why a merge queue is paused, on its card in the Progress panel (G18): after merging a card ({card}: its key), pushing the target ({target}: a branch) failed, for a sign-in, the network or a time limit; git's own message follows. “Push the target branch after merging” is a workflow option's name: use its words.

board.queue.pause.pushNoRemote.defaultMessage: {card} is merged, but {target} has no remote to push to: it tracks none, and the repository has no origin or only remote. Add one or set what {target} tracks, then resume; or turn off “Push the target branch after merging” and resume.
board.queue.pause.pushNoRemote.description: Why a merge queue is paused, on its card in the Progress panel (G18): after merging a card ({card}: its key), the target ({target}: a branch) had nowhere to be pushed. Origin is git's usual name for a remote: keep it. “Push the target branch after merging” is a workflow option's name: use its words.

board.queue.pause.pushRejected.defaultMessage: {card} is merged, but its remote refused the push of {target}: it has commits {target} hasn’t (Combwork never forces a push). Pull them into {target}, then resume; or turn off “Push the target branch after merging” and resume to keep merging locally.
board.queue.pause.pushRejected.description: Why a merge queue is paused, on its card in the Progress panel (G18): after merging a card ({card}: its key), pushing the target ({target}: a branch) was refused because the remote has newer commits. “Push the target branch after merging” is a workflow option's name: use its words.

board.queue.pause.pushUnreadable.defaultMessage: {card} is merged, and {target} still has to be pushed, but Combwork couldn’t read {target} to do it. Resume to try again; or turn off “Push the target branch after merging” and resume to keep merging locally.
board.queue.pause.pushUnreadable.description: Why a merge queue is paused, on its card in the Progress panel (G18): after merging a card ({card}: its key), Combwork couldn't read the target ({target}: a branch) to push it (git didn't answer), so the push still waits. “Push the target branch after merging” is a workflow option's name: use its words.

board.queue.pause.rulesOff.defaultMessage: The workflow's rules are off (Settings → Advanced), so the queue doesn't merge.
board.queue.pause.rulesOff.description: Why a merge queue is paused, on its card in the Progress panel: the workflow rules are turned off in Settings → Advanced.

board.queue.pause.signing.description: Why a merge queue is paused, on its card in the Progress panel: git's commit signing failed (its message follows).

board.queue.pause.signingWaits.defaultMessage: Signing the merge commit waits for you (a passphrase or a PIN). Unlock your signing key, then resume.
board.queue.pause.signingWaits.description: Why a merge queue is paused, on its card in the Progress panel: git's commit signing asked for a passphrase or PIN, which Combwork can't type.

board.queue.pause.staged.defaultMessage: Changes are staged in the folder {target} is checked out in. Commit or unstage them, then resume.
board.queue.pause.staged.description: Why a merge queue is paused, on its card in the Progress panel: the folder where the target ({target}: a branch) is checked out has staged changes.

board.queue.pause.subfolderTarget.defaultMessage: This project is inside a larger repository, so the queue merges only into a branch the card’s options name. Name it in Version Control → Workflow, apply it to {card} when you save, then resume; or remove {card} from the queue.
board.queue.pause.subfolderTarget.description: Why a merge queue is paused, on its card in the Progress panel (OP-29): the project is a subfolder of a bigger Git repository and the card's options name no target branch. {card} is the card's key. Version Control → Workflow is a place in Combwork (glossary 2.1); saving the options there can apply them to cards already started.

board.queue.pause.targetMovesFast.defaultMessage: {target} kept moving during each test merge. Resume once it settles.
board.queue.pause.targetMovesFast.description: Why a merge queue is paused, on its card in the Progress panel: the target ({target}: a branch) moved during every test merge. Glossary 2.5: test merge.

board.queue.pause.uncounted.defaultMessage: The merge checks passed but didn't count for the merge, several times in a row. The card's Work section says why.
board.queue.pause.uncounted.description: Why a merge queue is paused, on its card in the Progress panel: its checks passed but didn't count (the folder changed during them, say). Glossary 2.3: merge checks; 2.4: work.

board.queue.pause.unstagedChanges.defaultMessage: {files, select, none {Files the merge changes} other {{files}}} have changes in the folder {target} is checked out in. Commit or undo them, then resume.
board.queue.pause.unstagedChanges.description: Why a merge queue is paused, on its card in the Progress panel: files the merge would change ({files}: a list of names) have changes in the folder where the target ({target}: a branch) is checked out. Keep the select keys and the word none.

board.queue.pause.wrongBranch.defaultMessage: The folder {target} was checked out in is on another branch now.
board.queue.pause.wrongBranch.description: Why a merge queue is paused, on its card in the Progress panel: the folder that had the target ({target}: a branch) checked out switched branch.

board.queue.pauseFailed.description: An error's title: Pause queue failed (Progress panel).

board.queue.pauseTip.defaultMessage: Stop before the next card. A card in its merge checks finishes them and waits, unmerged.
board.queue.pauseTip.description: Tooltip of Pause queue on a merge queue's card in the Progress panel. Glossary 2.3: merge checks.

board.queue.pulse.defaultMessage: {target}: {state, select, paused {paused} other {testing {card}}}{n, plural, =0 {} other { · {n, number} queued}}
board.queue.pulse.description: A merge queue's line on the Progress panel's Pulse tab (a click shows the Merges tab): its target ({target}: a branch), paused or the card it tests ({card}: its key), and how many cards wait ({n}). Keep the select keys.

board.queue.queued.description: The cards waiting in a merge queue, in order, on its card in the Progress panel: {cards} is their keys as a list (HI-107, HI-108), {n} how many.

board.queue.recent.cancelled.defaultMessage: Taken out: {reason, select, removed {Remove from queue} stale {its pass no longer counted} hold {put On Hold} decision {a decision} integratedOutside {merged outside Combwork} followUp {a follow-up} other {cancelled}}
board.queue.recent.cancelled.description: An outcome in the Progress panel's Recent merges (Merges tab): the card's entry was taken out of the merge queue, and why (Remove from queue is a button's name; On Hold a column's). Keep the select keys.

board.queue.recent.heading.description: A heading under a merge queue's card in the Progress panel's Merges tab (HI-1924): the queue's latest outcomes (merged, returned, taken out) and pauses follow, newest first.

board.queue.recent.lasted.description: Beside a pause in the Progress panel's Recent merges: how long the merge queue stayed paused ({duration}: “12 min”, “under a minute”). Lower case.

board.queue.recent.merged.description: An outcome in the Progress panel's Recent merges (Merges tab): the merge queue merged the card. Its merge commit follows, as a short commit id.

board.queue.recent.more.description: A link after a merge queue's Recent merges in the Progress panel: its full history, in the project's Version Control tab (Merge queue section). Version Control is a place in Combwork.

board.queue.recent.none.description: Under Recent merges in the Progress panel's Merges tab, when the merge queue has merged, returned or paused nothing yet (or nothing of the agent the panel is filtered to).

board.queue.recent.paused.defaultMessage: Paused: {reason, select, user {by you} assistant {by the Assistant} pushRejected {the remote refused the push} pushFailed {the push failed} pushNoRemote {no remote to push to} pushUnreadable {couldn’t read the branch to push it} targetMovesFast {the branch kept moving} folderBusy {its folder was busy} wrongBranch {its folder changed branch} staged {changes staged in its folder} unstagedChanges {changes in its folder} identity {no commit identity} needsYou {needs you} uncounted {the checks didn’t count} checkedOut {the branch was checked out} rulesOff {the rules were off} signingWaits {signing waited for you} signing {signing failed} hookTimedOut {a hook ran too long} subfolderTarget {no target branch named} mergeChoice {waiting for how to merge} approval {waiting for your OK} focusedSkip {waiting for your OK to skip focused tests} other {{code}}}
board.queue.recent.paused.description: A pause in the Progress panel's Recent merges (Merges tab): the merge queue paused, and why in a few words (by the user or the Assistant; the push of the target branch refused, failed, with no remote or unreadable (G18); the branch moving, its checked-out folder busy, on another branch, with staged or other changes; no git identity; needs the user; checks that didn't count; rules off; commit signing; a git hook; no target branch for a project in a subfolder; the merge style choice after the upgrade; the user's approval; skipping focused tests). Else {code}, Combwork's code for it. Lower case after the colon. Keep the select keys.

board.queue.recent.push.defaultMessage: {state, select, pushed {Pushed} pending {Not pushed yet} off {Not pushed: pushing was turned off} reset {Not pushed: the branch no longer had it} other {Push not recorded}}
board.queue.recent.push.description: Beside a merge in the Progress panel's Recent merges (Merges tab), when the workflow pushes the target branch after merging (G18): pushed; not pushed yet; not pushed because the option was turned off, or because the branch was reset and no longer had the merge; or Combwork has no record of its push (an older merge). Keep the select keys.

board.queue.recent.returned.description: An outcome in the Progress panel's Recent merges (Merges tab): the merge queue returned the card to its builder, and why ({why}: conflict in tasks.ts, checks failed: unit…). Glossary 2.4: returned.

board.queue.recent.stillPaused.description: Beside a pause in the Progress panel's Recent merges: the merge queue is paused now (the pause hasn't ended). Lower case.

board.queue.recent.took.description: Beside an outcome in the Progress panel's Recent merges: how long the merge queue took over the card, its merge checks and merge ({duration}: “12 min”, “under a minute”). Lower case.

board.queue.remove.description: A button beside a queued card on a merge queue's card in the Progress panel: Remove from queue (asks first). Keep it short.

board.queue.removeConfirm.description: The button confirming Remove from queue. Keep it short.

board.queue.removeFailed.defaultMessage: Couldn't remove the card from the queue
board.queue.removeFailed.description: An error's title: Remove from queue failed (Progress panel); its message says why (its merge has begun, say).

board.queue.removeMessage.defaultMessage: It goes back to Approved and isn't merged. Its builder is told. To merge it later, requeue it from the card.
board.queue.removeMessage.description: The confirmation before Remove from queue (Progress panel). Approved is a stage (glossary 2.2).

board.queue.removeNamed.description: Accessible name of Remove from queue on a queued card ({card}: its key) on a merge queue's card in the Progress panel.

board.queue.removeTitle.description: Title of the confirmation before Remove from queue ({card}: the card's key). Glossary 2.5: merge queue.

board.queue.resume.description: A button on a paused merge queue's card in the Progress panel: clears the pause once its cause is fixed. Glossary 2.5: Resume queue.

board.queue.resumeFailed.description: An error's title: Resume queue failed (Progress panel).

board.queue.returnWhy.defaultMessage: {reason, select, conflict {{files, select, none {conflict} other {conflict in {files}}}} checks {{check, select, none {checks failed} other {checks failed: {check}}}} hook {a hook failed} folderBusy {the folder {target} is checked out in was busy} notUpToDate {not up to date with {target}} focused {its focused tests couldn’t be chosen or proved} other {{why}}}
board.queue.returnWhy.description: Why the merge queue returned a card to its builder, in a few words after a colon: a conflict (in {files}: file names), its merge checks failed ({check}: the check, such as unit), a git hook failed, the folder the target ({target}: a branch) is checked out in was busy, or it wasn't up to date with the target, or its focused tests (G20: the tests its change needs) couldn't be chosen or proved by its review; else {why} as Combwork recorded it. Lower case. Keep the select keys and the word none.

board.queue.returned.description: A merge queue's card in the Progress panel: a card ({card}: its key) the queue returned (glossary 2.4: returned), and why ({why}: conflict in tasks.ts, checks failed: unit…).

board.queue.returnedTo.description: A merge queue's card in the Progress panel: a card ({card}: its key) the queue returned to its builder ({builder}: an agent's name; glossary 2.4: returned), and why ({why}: conflict in tasks.ts, checks failed: unit…). A noun before the name (glossary §1 rule 4).

board.queue.runBy.description: On a merge queue's card in the Progress panel: another Combwork on this workspace runs the queue ({profile}: its profile's name, such as Combwork-Dev). A noun before the name (glossary §1 rule 4).

board.queue.saidMerged.description: Announced to screen readers (politely) when the merge queue merged a card ({card}: its key, such as HI-61).

board.queue.saidPaused.description: Announced to screen readers (politely) when a merge queue paused ({target}: its branch). Glossary 2.5: merge queue.

board.queue.saidResumed.description: Announced to screen readers (politely) when a merge queue resumed ({target}: its branch). Glossary 2.5: merge queue.

board.queue.saidReturned.description: Announced to screen readers (politely) when the merge queue returned a card ({card}: its key) to its builder, and why ({why}: conflict, checks failed: unit…). Glossary 2.4: returned.

board.queue.showLog.description: A button on a merge queue's returned card in the Progress panel: shows the failed check's log (or the hook's output).

board.queue.showLogFailed.description: An error's title: Show log on a merge queue's returned card failed (Progress panel).

board.queue.sofar.description: How long the merge queue has been testing its card ({sofar}: "3 min"), on its card in the Progress panel, with no estimate (no earlier merge checks to go by).

board.queue.sofarOf.description: How long the merge queue has been testing its card ({sofar}: "3 min") and how long its merge checks usually take ({estimate}: "12 min", the median of the last ones), on its card in the Progress panel.

board.queue.step.defaultMessage: {step, select, testMerge {test merge} checks {merge checks} check {check: {check}} advance {merging into {target}} other {testing}}
board.queue.step.description: The step a merge queue's card is at now, in the Progress panel: the test merge, its merge checks (or the one running, {check}: its name, such as unit), merging into the target ({target}: a branch, such as main), or testing (step not known here). Lower case: it follows an arrow. Glossary 2.5: test merge; 2.3: merge checks. Keep the select keys.

board.queue.stillPaused.defaultMessage: The merge queue is still paused
board.queue.stillPaused.description: A notification's title after Resume queue: what paused it still holds, so it paused again. Its message says why.

board.queue.testing.description: What a merge queue is testing now, on its card in the Progress panel: the card ({card}: its key, such as HI-61) merged with the target ({target}: a branch, such as main) at its head ({head}: a short commit id), and its step ({step}: test merge, check: unit…).

board.queue.testingNoHead.description: What a merge queue is testing now, on its card in the Progress panel: the card ({card}: its key, such as HI-61) merged with the target ({target}: a branch, such as main), and its step ({step}: test merge, check: unit…).

board.queue.title.description: The heading of a merge queue's card in the Progress panel ({target}: the branch it merges into, such as main). Glossary 2.5: merge queue.

board.queue.transient.description: A merge queue return that was the environment's failure, not the work's (a check that couldn't start, a network error): its reason ({why}) and that it was temporary.

board.readOnly.newer.defaultMessage: This board was saved by a newer version of Combwork: it is read-only here.
board.readOnly.newer.description: Tooltip on what changes cards (the board's add-card buttons, the card dialog's Save, comments and decisions), disabled while the board was saved by a newer Combwork (whose format this one can't change); also a banner in the card dialog.

board.restore09.done.description: A notification after the 0.9 board backup was put back.

board.restore09.doneDetail.description: Under "The 0.9 board is back": {file} is the file the board as it was before the restore was saved to.

board.restore09.message.defaultMessage: Combwork keeps a copy of the board as it is now, then puts back the copy made before its upgrade to 1.0 ({when}). Changes made since are only in the kept copy. The board is then read-only here: quit this Combwork and open the workspace in version 0.9 to carry on.
board.restore09.message.description: The confirmation before restoring the 0.9 board backup. {when} is when the backup was made (a date and time).

board.restore09.none.defaultMessage: There is no 0.9 board backup to restore
board.restore09.none.description: A notification from Help → Restore the 0.9 Board Backup… when the workspace has no copy of its board from before an upgrade to 1.0.

board.restore09.restore.description: The button of the confirmation: puts the 0.9 board backup back.

board.restore09.restoring.description: The Restore button while the 0.9 board backup is put back.

board.restore09.title.description: Title of the confirmation before Help → Restore the 0.9 Board Backup… puts back the copy of the board Combwork kept when it upgraded it to 1.0.

board.review.line.description: A card's reviewer line on the board: who is reviewing it and since when ({ago}: "5 min ago").

board.review.lineNotRunning.description: A card's reviewer line on the board, in amber: its reviewer's session isn't running.

board.review.lineRemoved.description: A card's reviewer line on the board, in amber: its reviewer was removed from the project.

board.review.tip.defaultMessage: {agent} is reviewing it (since {ago}). Click to show it.
